title: Executive Assistant- Healthcare
description:
We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and compassionate Administrative & Community Support Virtual Assistant to support the day-to-day operations of a growing outpatient mental health organization.

This role combines administrative support, tracking management, referral coordination, recruitment assistance, social media support, and community engagement. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, dependable, and possesses strong customer service skills, especially when interacting with clients, families, referral partners, and community members in sensitive situations.

The ideal candidate should also be comfortable working in fast-paced environments, managing multiple responsibilities, and utilizing technology and AI tools to improve workflow efficiency.



---

• Update client and referral progress throughout each stage of the intake process

• Ensure tracking systems remain accurate, organized, and up to date

• Support quality control efforts through proper documentation and follow-up



**Referral Program Coordination**

• Conduct follow-up calls within 24–48 hours after events to thank attendees and provide additional information

• Maintain communication with parents and community members for surveys and feedback collection

**Administrative & Executive Support**

• Monitor and respond to
s, voi
s, and electronic faxes, particularly authorization requests

• Organize documents, charts, rosters, and administrative records

• Create reports, spreadsheets, and workflow tracking documents as needed

• Send outreach
s and communication materials to future community partners and providers



**Recruitment & Community Partnership Support**

• Sort and organize sign-up sheets collected from career fairs and community events

• Create and maintain organized rosters for job seekers, mentors, interns, and externs

• Request resumes and required onboarding documents from applicants

• Conduct initial eligibility checks and assist with interview scheduling

• Manage intern and externship tracking, including program details, required hours, and onboarding timelines

• Support recruitment initiatives for community partners, new hires, and interns

**Social Media & Community Engagement**

title: Appointment Setter
description:
We are seeking a confident, personable, and highly reliable Appointment Setter to manage inbound calls and warm leads generated through paid advertising. This is a full-time, client-facing role that combines the precision of a sales qualifier with the professionalism of a front-desk receptionist.

The ideal candidate answers calls promptly, engages prospects with warmth and clarity, qualifies leads against defined criteria, and books appointments with a high conversion rate. They are fully dedicated to this role — not splitting time across multiple clients — and are committed to showing up consistently throughout the full shift window. This role is worked through the GrowHub 360 CRM system



---



## Key Responsibilities



**Inbound Call Handling & Virtual Reception**

• Answer all inbound calls from ad campaigns (Thrive) promptly and professionally

• Serve as the first point of contact for prospective clients inquiring about services

• Provide clear, accurate, and helpful information about available services and next steps

• Assist callers who are looking to change providers by explaining the transition process

• Maintain a consistent, friendly, and professional tone on every call



**Lead Qualification & Appointment Setting**

• Qualify warm inbound leads from funnels and ad campaigns against defined eligibility criteria

• Guide qualified prospects through the sales process from initial inquiry to confirmed appointment

• Book appointments accurately within the scheduling system and confirm details with each prospect

• Follow up with leads who did not book on the first call to re-engage and convert

• Meet and maintain a strong appointment conversion rate as a key performance benchmark



**CRM Management & Lead Tracking**

• Work within GrowHub 360 (Go High Level) to manage, update, and track all inbound leads

• Log call outcomes, lead status, and appointment details accurately after every interaction

• Ensure no leads fall through the cracks by maintaining an organized and up-to-date pipeline

• Flag unresponsive or unqualified leads appropriately within the CRM for review

• Pull basic reports or updates on lead activity and appointment volume as requested



**Client Communication & Follow-Up**

• Send appointment confirmations and reminders to booked clients ahead of scheduled dates

• Conduct follow-up calls or messages for no-shows and rescheduling requests

• Respond to general inquiries and direct clients to the appropriate tea
mber when needed

• Maintain clear and professional communication throughout the entire client experience

• Support a smooth handoff from the appointment setting stage to the service delivery team



---



## Requirements



**Essential Skills**

•Excellent verbal communication skills with a warm, clear, and confident phone presence

•Proven ability to qualify leads and convert inbound inquiries into booked appointments

• Strong time management and the ability to handle high call volumes without sacrificing quality

• Reliable, punctual, and fully committed to the full-time schedule and shift hours

ntum

We built an Apple Watch app specifically for pickleball players to track their games, stats, and progress. Pickleball is one of the fastest-growing sports in the US — and we're building the go-to tool for players who take their game seriously.



We want you to play a huge role in helping us grow. This is an exciting long-term opportunity, and as you grow, the role can grow with you.



So, are you ready?



JOB OVERVIEW

Main Responsibilities and Skills Needed:

-TikTok, Instagram, and Reddit content posting and community engagement

-Engagement farming — creating and distributing content designed to drive likes, comments, shares, and saves

-Organic community outreach and messaging across social platforms

-Supporting AI-based marketing automations (tools and training provided)

-Staying current on pickleball trends, viral content, and platform algorithm changes

-Tech savvy — comfortable learning new tools quickly

-Solid written English — natural, conversational, native-sounding



Here are specific examples of what you'll be handling week to week:

-Post and manage content on TikTok, Instagram, and Reddit accounts

-Engage with the pickleball community — comment on posts, respond to DMs, join conversations

-Conduct direct outreach via DM to pickleball content creators and active players

-Monitor and participate in Reddit pickleball communities (r/pickleball, etc.)

-Flag trending content and 
nts in the pickleball world to capitalize on

-Support and maintain AI automation workflows

-Report weekly on what's working, what's not, and what to try next



DESCRIPTION OF IDEAL CANDIDATE

Young and Social Media Native

You grew up on TikTok and Instagram. You understand how content moves, what makes people stop scrolling, and how communities actually talk to each other. You don't need to be told what's trending — you already know.



AI-Fluent, Not AI-Dependent

You know how to use AI tools to work faster and smarter — whether that's for research, scheduling, automation, or ideation. But you also know the difference between content that feels human and content that screams "AI wrote this." We have zero tolerance for AI slop. If you use AI, it's a tool, not a ghostwriter.



Gets Stuff Done

You take charge and make things happen. You don't make excuses. You have an internal drive to grow something and you'll do whatever it takes.



Self Starter

You're self-motivated and happy working independently. You don't sit around waiting to be told what to do next.



Creative

You have an eye for what will resonate with an audience. You know the difference between content that flops and content that hits — and you're always thinking about how to make the next post better than the last.



Solves Problems

When something isn't working, you figure out why and try something different. You don't wait to be told.



Takes Ownership

You love having responsibility. You want to be the person who makes something succeed.



Growth-Minded

You're always learning. You stay on top of platform changes, new tools, and what's working in the social media space right now.



You Do What You Say

If you commit to something, you follow through. Simple as that.



COMPANY CULTURE

We're direct and transparent. We work hard, move fast, and have fun doing it. You'll work closely with the founder — communication is open and feedback is immediate. If something isn't working, we talk about it and fix it.



PAY

200–250 PHP per hour, based on ability and experience. Part-time (~10 hours/week) to start, with a direct path to full-time based on results. If you believe you have more to offer, tell us what you'd like and why.



CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS

-Honest and reliable

-Strong written English — natural, conversational tone

-Actively uses TikTok, Instagram, and Reddit personally (not just professionally)

-Comfortable with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, automation platforms, etc.) — but creates original, human-feeling content

-Own computer with reliable internet connection

-Comfortable with video calls during late US Pacific Time hours



Working Hours

Part-time (~10 hours/week). Preferred overlap with late US Pacific Time (evenings PST / mornings PHT).



HOW TO APPLY

Message a short cover letter + resume as a response to this job post.



To apply, start your cover letter and your onlinejobs.ph message response header with: "Pickleball Ready"



Also please send a short video (2 minutes max, Loom or YouTube link) introducing yourself and telling us: what's one piece of content you've seen recently that you thought was genius, and why? No templates — make it personal.



We look forward to working with you.

title: Full Stack Mobile Developer (React Native, Capacitor, iOS/Android, NestJS, AWS)
description:
FULL STACK MOBILE DEVELOPER (React Native, Capacitor, iOS/Android, NestJS, AWS)





JOB OVERVIEW



We're building a mobile engagement platform built on the premise of gamification and rewards. Users complete real-world challenges, submit proof, earn points, and unlock rewards and recognition. Think Duolingo + Strava + ClassDojo.



Behind the mobile app is a full backend for creating challenges and rewards and managing content. The platform is multi-tenant: many organizations run on one system, each with its own challenges, rewards, members, and content, fully isolated from one another.



This is a long-term opportunity to help build the next version of a live platform that already has real users on both the Apple App Store and Google Play. The stack is modern and already locked in, the roadmap is clear, and you'll work directly with our existing development lead and CTO. You'll own real features end to end — from the database model, to the API, to the mobile app in users' hands.



A major near-term focus is a TikTok-style vertical video feed and a real-time AI feature, so video streaming and AI experience are a strong plus.





PLEASE NOTE



We are hiring an individual, not an agency or development firm. This is a full-time, exclusive position — we expect this to be your only job. Working with other clients at the same time is not allowed. Applications from agencies, teams, or anyone representing a company will not be considered.





RESPONSIBILITIES



• Build and ship the mobile app for both iOS (Apple App Store) and Android (Google Play) — React Native (Expo) for the next version, while also maintaining our current production app built with Capacitor during the transition



• Own the full mobile release process: builds, code signing, provisioning profiles, and store submissions and updates on App Store Connect and Google Play Console



• Develop the web admin dashboard (Next.js / React) where organizations create challenges and rewards and manage their content



• Build and maintain backend services in NestJS / Node.js on AWS (serverless + containers)



• Design and query a multi-tenant PostgreSQL (RDS) database — every record scoped per organization and fully isolated



• Build a vertical, TikTok-style video feed: smooth playback, preloading, and recycled players inside a virtualized list



• Set up and extend the video pipeline: S3 uploads, transcoding with AWS MediaConvert, adaptive bitrate (HLS) streaming, and delivery through CloudFront



• Integrate AI features using OpenAI and Anthropic (Claude) APIs, including RAG / vector search with pgvector



• Write clean, well-tested, well-commented production code, and keep work visible with frequent commits and clear updates





TECH STACK (you should know it or be willing to learn it)



• Mobile: React Native, Expo, Capacitor, iOS and Android app development, App Store Connect, Google Play Console



• Frontend / Web: Next.js, React, TypeScript



• Backend: NestJS, Node.js, REST APIs



• Cloud: AWS — Lambda / serverless, ECS, RDS, S3, CloudFront, MediaConvert



• Database: PostgreSQL, RDS, pgvector, multi-tenant data modeling



• Video: HLS / adaptive bitrate streaming, video transcoding, in-feed playback performance



• AI: OpenAI and Anthropic (Claude) APIs, RAG pipelines, vector search



• Tooling: Git / GitHub, GitHub Actions (CI/CD), Docker





PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



• Strong full-stack experience (React Native / Next.js + NestJS / Node.js, TypeScript throughout)



• Proven mobile app development for both iOS and Android — building, code signing, provisioning, and publishing to the Apple App Store and Google Play



• Familiarity with Capacitor (it powers our current production app during the transition to React Native)



• Real PostgreSQL depth — schema design, query performance, migrations, and multi-tenant data modeling



• Hands-on AWS experience (serverless, RDS, S3)



• Experience building video playback / streaming features (HLS, in-feed video, smooth performance on low-end Android)



• Past work with AI / LLM features — RAG, embeddings, streaming responses



• Bonus: native iOS (Swift) / Android (Kotlin) development and native module bridging (Swift / Kotlin to React Native) — useful for device-specific debugging and the path toward future camera / AR filter features



• Bonus: experience with multi-tenant application architecture



• Bonus: consumer or gamified product experience where engagement and retention matter





JOB DETAILS



• Full-time, 40 hrs/week — this is a full-time, exclusive role. We expect this to be your only job; working with other clients at the same time is not allowed.



• Individuals only — we are hiring a person, not an agency or development firm. Please do not apply if you represent a company or team.



• Fully remote / work-from-home



• Long-term contract with opportunity for growth



• Monthly salary in USD, based on experience







HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



• Resume / CV



• GitHub or code samples (especially mobile, video, or AI-related work)



• A short message about your experience shipping iOS and Android apps, video streaming, or LLM features



• Your expected monthly salary in USD

title: Video Editor
description:
READ ME!!!

!!!

-----



The Video Editor is the primary craftsperson behind 
's content output: transforming raw founder footage into polished, scroll-stopping video built to convert. The day-to-day focus is short-form vertical content (IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, TikTok), but this is a well-rounded editing role, and as the brand expands the work will grow to include other formats such as long-form YouTube, ads, and client deliverables. This person works from the briefs, scripts, and hooks provided by the Content Strategist, edits with pace, captions, motion graphics, and sound design, maintains a consistent brand identity across every channel, manages the raw-to-final file pipeline, hits a reliable publishing cadence, and builds reusable templates and editing systems that can eventually be deployed for 
 clients.



ABOUT THE ROLE

  • Industry: Growth Consulting

  • Title: Video Editor

  • Availability: Part-Time (Up to 20 Hours) | Monday to Friday Asynchronous; Collaboration between 7am-11am ET

  • Reports To: Founder

  • Wage: $5.00 USD/hr; paid via Wise



RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Edit raw founder footage into high-quality video optimized for retention and conversion, with a primary focus on short-form vertical content (IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, TikTok) and the flexibility to take on other   • formats as the brand expands

  • Add captions, motion graphics, kinetic typography, b-roll, transitions, and sound design consistent with brand standards

  • Work from briefs, scripts, and hooks provided by the Content Strategist to execute the content vision faithfully

  • Manage the end-to-end raw-to-final pipeline in Google Drive, keeping footage organized, versioned, and easy to retrieve

  • Maintain a consistent visual identity and brand standards across all videos and designated channels

  • Produce multiple cuts, formats, and aspect ratios from a single recording session to maximize output per shoot

  • Meet agreed turnaround times so editing never bottlenecks the publishing schedule

  • Incorporate viewer retention data and strategist feedback to continually refine pacing, hooks, and editing style

  • Build and maintain reusable editing templates, presets, and asset libraries to accelerate production

  • Re-cut and repurpose top-performing organic content into variations for paid ad campaigns

  • Document all editing workflows, templates, and standards to create repeatable systems that can eventually be deployed for 
 clients

  • Maintain open communication and attend syncs during the core 7 AM to 11 AM ET collaboration window to review feedback, align on briefs, and adjust output





RESULTS

By Day 30: Established and Operational

  • Editing workflow and file pipeline mapped out and communication flow established with the Content Strategist (raw intake to edit to delivery)

  • Brand editing standards defined and applied consistently (captions, fonts, color, pacing, music)

  • First batches of edited short-form videos delivered and published on schedule

  • Baseline turnaround times and weekly output capacity established

By Day 60: Independent and Producing

  • Consistent editing cadence maintained across all designated channels without founder intervention

  • Reusable templates, presets, and asset libraries built and in active use

  • Multiple cuts and variations produced from each recording session to maximize output

  • Editing decisions informed by viewer retention metrics and strategist feedback

By Day 90: Owning the Function

  • Full editing function owned: from raw intake to final, platform-ready deliverables

  • Top-performing organic content re-cut into variations and positioned for paid ad campaigns

  • All editing workflows, templates, and standards thoroughly documented into repeatable systems

  • Founder's day-to-day involvement reduced strictly to recording footage and attending weekly syncs

Beyond 90 Days: Scaling the Function

  • Editing systems packaged, refined, and ready to be deployed for 
 clients

  • Ad-variation production running smoothly to support paid campaigns based on proven organic winners

  • Proactive adoption of new editing techniques, formats, and platform shifts to keep the brand ahead of the curve

  • Acts as a trusted production partner to leadership on content quality and creative direction





REQUIREMENTS

  • 2-4 years in Video Editing, Content Production, or a similar creative production role

  • Well-rounded editor with a primary strength in short-form vertical video (IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, or TikTok) and comfort across other formats such as long-form and ads; strong portfolio or reel required

  • Expert in at least one professional editing suite (Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or CapCut Pro, Descript or other)

  • Skilled in captioning, motion graphics, kinetic typography, sound design, and basic color correction

  • Strong instinct for pacing, hooks, and retention editing, with a sharp sense for what holds attention in a social feed

  • Background working from briefs and scripts and coordinating closely with a content strategist or creative lead

  • Highly organized in managing raw and final assets in Google Drive and project management tools (Notion, ClickUp, Asana, etc.)

  • Comfortable producing multiple cuts, aspect ratios, and ad variations quickly and efficiently

  • Proactive, self-directed, and detail-oriented; able to work asynchronously while honoring the required 7 AM to 11 AM ET collaboration window

title: Book Keeper - online
description:
We are building something special across three separate ventures and we need someone equally special to own

our numbers completely. This is not a data-entry role — this is a strategic bookkeeping position where you will

take full ownership of the financial records for all three entities, ensure complete compliance with Australian tax

law, and give our leadership team the clarity and confidence to make bold decisions.



You will work remotely from the Philippines, coordinate daily with Beth, and report directly to Corey.

You will be the single source of financial truth across Reset Sanctuary, 4QTR & Experiences, and Walk With Me.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Full-Charge Bookkeeping — All Three Entities

– Maintain accurate, up-to-date books for all three organisations simultaneously

– Manage the chart of accounts, general ledger, and bank reconciliations for each entity

– Prepare accounts payable and accounts receivable across all businesses

– Record and categorise all income, expenses, and inter-entity transactions correctly

– Manage petty cash, credit card reconciliations, and supplier payments



2. Australian Tax Compliance

– Prepare and lodge Business Activity Statements (BAS) monthly/quarterly via the ATO Business Portal

– Ensure accurate GST reporting, claiming, and reconciliation across all entities

– Manage PAYG Withholding obligations — payroll tax reporting and remittance to the ATO

– Adhere to Single Touch Payroll (STP) Phase 2 requirements via the payroll system

– Maintain awareness of Fringe Benefits Tax (FBT) obligations where applicable

– Support year-end tax preparation and liaise with the external accountant (Emandem) at EOFY

– Monitor ATO correspondence and ensure all lodgement deadlines are met without exception



3. Payroll Processing

– Process weekly/fortnightly payroll for all staff across Reset Sanctuary, 4QTR and Walk With Me

– Calculate and apply correct superannuation  to all eligible employees

– Manage leave accruals, termination payments, and entitlement tracking under the Fair Work Act

– Submit STP-compliant payroll data to the ATO via the approved payroll platform

– Maintain accurate employee records including TFN declarations and employment contracts



4. Not-for-Profit Bookkeeping — Walk With Me

– Maintain separate, compliant books for the not-for-profit entity

– Track restricted and unrestricted funds, grants, and donations with full acquittal records

– Prepare financial reports suitable for the Walk With Me board and any external reporting obligations

– Ensure compliance with ACNC governance and financial reporting standards where applicable

– Manage DGR-related records if Walk With Me holds Deductible Gift Recipient status



5. Financial Reporting

– Produce monthly Profit & Loss statements, Balance Sheets, and Cash Flow reports for each entity

– Deliver a consolidated financial summary to Corey by the 5th of each month

– Build and maintain dashboards that give real-time visibility over revenue, expenses, and cash position

– Flag anomalies, unusual variances, or cashflow concerns proactively — don't wait to be asked



6. Software & Systems Management

– Own the bookkeeping platforms (Xero preferred) across all three entities

– Maintain integrations between Xero and payment systems, payroll platforms, and CRM where applicable

– Ensure digital records are organised, backed up, and audit-ready at all times

– Identify and implement efficiencies in financial workflows and reporting processes



REQUIRED AUSTRALIAN TAX & COMPLIANCE KNOWLEDGE



You must have working knowledge of the following. These are non-negotiable.

– Goods and Services Tax (GST) — 10% application, exemptions, BAS lodgement

– Business Activity Statements (BAS) — monthly and quarterly cycles, ATO portal lodgement

– Pay As You Go (PAYG) Withholding — calculation, reporting, and ATO remittance

– Single Touch Payroll (STP) Phase 2 — employer obligations and payroll platform compliance

– Superannuation Guarantee — current SG rate, Super Stream compliance, fund remittance

deadlines

– Australian Taxation Office (ATO) correspondence management and lodgement calendars

– Director Penalty Notices (DPN) — understanding of PAYG and SGC lockdown provisions

– Fair Work Act — leave entitlements, minimum wages, termination payment calculations

– Fringe Benefits Tax (FBT) — basic awareness and flagging obligations

– Not-for-Profit tax obligations — income tax exemption requirements, ACNC, DGR records

– Australian Accounting Standards — accrual vs cash accounting principles

– Xero or equivalent cloud accounting platform — advanced user level



SKILLS, QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE



Essential

– Minimum 3 years experience in full-charge bookkeeping, preferably for multiple entities simultaneously

– Demonstrated experience working with Australian businesses and the Australian tax system

– Advanced Xero skills — certification strongly preferred

– Proven BAS preparation and lodgement experience

– STP payroll processing experience

– Excellent English written and verbal communication — must be able to brief Corey and Beth clearly

– High attention to detail and zero tolerance for errors in financial records

– Strong time management — ability to meet all ATO lodgement deadlines independently

– Comfortable working independently in a remote environment with minimal supervision



Desirable

– Degree or diploma in Accounting, Finance, or Business

– Xero Certified Advisor status

– Prior experience managing a not-for-profit entity & books

– Familiarity with the Australian Small Business and hospitality / wellness industry

– Experience with booking systems, GoHighLevel (GHL), or similar CR
mbership systems



REPORTING & COMMUNICATION STRUCTURE



Day-to-Day Accountability ? Beth

Beth is your primary operational contact. She will manage task prioritisation, flag urgent items, relay

questions from the team, and ensure you have everything needed to do your job. Daily or near-daily

communication with Beth is expected.

Strategic Reporting ? Corey McKernan (Founder)

You report directly to Corey for all matters of financial significance — monthly reports, compliance

obligations, ATO issues, and anything requiring a strategic decision. Corey expects a monthly

financial briefing and ad-hoc escalation when required. He values directness, proactivity, and people

who surface problems before they become crises.

External Accountant Liaison ? Emandem

You will work alongside Mark at Emandem (external accountant) at EOFY, for any tax planning, and

for complex compliance matters. Your role is to keep the books clean enough that Mark's time is

spent on strategy, not cleaning up data.

title: AU Credit Analyst
description:
Experience in AU Lender Mortgage side is needed for this role.



Job Brief  



We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Credit Analyst to support our lenders in managing the end-to-end mortgage application process. This role requires a professional with a minimum of 3 to 4 years of specific Australian mortgage and lending experience; as such, we are looking for a candidate who can hit the ground running without the need for foundational training. You will be responsible for the entire lifecycle of a loan, from lead conversion and data entry to credit assessment and post-settlement enquiries. While you will receive initial support, you are expected to take full ownership of your workflow, ensuring all applications meet rigorous credit policies and legislative standards. 



Responsibilities 

Salesforce & LoanApp Management: Managing accurate data entry within Salesforce and overseeing the LoanApp platform to ensure seamless application flows. 

Lead Conversion: Creating leads and converting them into opportunities within the CRM system. 

Application Submission: Submitting completed loan applications to the funder and issuing credit guides where applicable. 

Valuation Management: Ordering and managing valuation reports to ensure property security meets lending criteria. 

Reporting & Title Searches: Generating comprehensive credit reports and completing necessary title searches. 

Progress Draw Management: Overseeing the management of progress draws for construction or staged funding. 

KYC Compliance: Completing Know Your Customer (KYC) verifications using tools such as IDyou or IDkit. 

Documentation & Signatures: Completing all required application forms and coordinating the sending of documents for digital signatures. 

Financial Calculations: Completing funding tables and servicing calculators to determine borrower capacity. 

Credit Proposal Drafting: Drafting detailed credit proposals for formal credit assessment. 

Credit Assessment: Assessing applications prior to submission to the senior credit analyst for final review. 

Policy Compliance: Reviewing credit limits in line with specific internal policies and procedures.

Approval Recommendations: Recommending applications for approval or decline based on risk analysis. 

Underwriter Liaison: Dealing with underwriter Mortgage Information Requests (MIR) and resolving technical queries. 

Outcome Notification: Issuing formal approval or decline letters to relevant parties. 

Settlement Support: Assisting with a wide range of pre-settlement and post-settlement enquiries. 



Requirements 

3–4 years of direct experience in Australian mortgage lending (lender-side experience is essential; broker-side only will not be considered). 

Proven ability to handle the end-to-end loan process with minimal supervision. 

Deep understanding of Australian credit policies and lending benchmarks. 

Advanced analytical, mathematical, and comprehension skills. 

Ability to manage competing deadlines effectively in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment. 

Exceptional attention to detail with the ability to identify discrepancies in complex financial data. 

Strong communication skills for interacting with underwriters and internal stakeholders. 



Software Proficiency 

Salesforce (nice to have) 

LoanApp 

IDyou / IDkit 

Credit Reporting Tools (Equifax / Illion) 

Servicing Calculators 

Microsoft Office Suite 



Education 

Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, or other business-related fields. 

Additional certifications in Australian Mortgage Broking or Financial Services are highly desirable. 



Personal Attributes 

Critical thinking – Ability to evaluate applications objectively and identify potential risks. 

Consistent and methodical – A disciplined approach to following processes and procedures. 

Persistence – Dedication to seeing complex applications through to completion and resolving MIRs. 

Team orientated – A collaborative mindset focused on supporting lenders and the wider credit team. 

Love of learning – A desire to stay updated on evolving Australian lending regulations and policies. 



Time Zone: Australian Business Hours 



Applicant Location: Must be located in the Philippines

title: Wordpress SEO Content Optimizer for Pinterest Cleaning Blog Funnel
description:
is a practical home-cleaning website focused on helping busy households keep their homes cleaner, fresher, and easier to manage through simple routines, room-by-room cleaning guides, printable checklists, product recommendations, home freshness advice, laundry tips, dust control, floor cleaning, and odor removal.



The site is being optimized for a Pinterest-driven monetization funnel:



Pinterest pins ? helpful cleaning articles ? free printable checklist signup ? paid cleaning planner offer ? affiliate/product recommendations.



The goal is to position 
 as a simple cleaning systems and printable checklist brand, not a broad general home-tips blog.



The main content categories we are building around are:



Cleaning Checklists

Cleaning Schedules

Room-by-Room Cleaning

Home Freshness & Odor Removal

Dust Control & Air Quality

Floor Cleaning

Laundry & Fabric Care

Cleaning Tools & Product Reviews

Pest Prevention Cleaning



I need someone who can help optimize existing articles so they are more useful, more Pinterest-friendly, better organized, better internally linked, and more connected to the site’s free checklist and paid cleaning planner funnel.



Position Title



WordPress SEO Content Optimizer for Pinterest Cleaning Blog Funnel



Job Overview



I am looking for a detail-oriented WordPress SEO Content Optimizer to improve existing blog posts on 
.



This is not a general writing job. This is not just basic proofreading. This is not only keyword stuffing or generic SEO editing.



The job is to take existing articles and make them stronger for:



Pinterest traffic

reader usefulness

 signups

printable checklist downloads

paid planner sales

affiliate/product recommendations

internal linking

clear site organization



Each optimized article should feel practical, helpful, and connected to a clear cleaning problem. The reader should come away thinking, “This is useful. I should save this, print this, or download the checklist.”



Main Responsibilities



For each assigned article, you will:



Review the current article and identify the best Pinterest-friendly angle.

Improve the article title if needed while keeping the existing URL unless I approve a URL change.

Rewrite or improve the introduction so it immediately connects to a cleaning, freshness, laundry, floor, dust, room reset, or home routine problem.

Add a short “Quick Answer” section near the top when appropriate.

Improve the article structure using clear H2 and H3 headings.

Add a practical checklist section that readers would want to save, print, or pin.

Add a “Mistakes to Avoid” section when useful.

Add or improve a “Recommended Tools/Supplies” section when appropriate.

Add 4-8 relevant internal links to related 
 articles.

Add a free checklist call-to-action near the top and bottom.

Add a soft mention of the paid Simple Clean Home Quick Reset Planner near the bottom.

Suggest 3-5 Pinterest pin titles for the article.

Recommend the best WordPress category for the article.

Make the post easier to read with short paragraphs, bullets, and clear formatting.

Check that links are working.

Submit changes for approval before publishing unless I give publishing permission.

What Every Optimized Article Should Include



Each priority article should include most or all of the following:



Pinterest-friendly title

Strong problem-focused intro

Quick answer section

Clear step-by-step advice

Printable-style checklist

Mistakes to avoid

Recommended tools or supplies

Internal links to related posts

Free checklist CTA

Paid planner CTA

Suggested Pinterest pin titles

Suggested category

SEO title and meta description

Important Rules



Do not change URLs unless I specifically approve it.



Do not publish changes during the trial without approval.



Do not remove useful information unless it is off-topic, weak, or no longer fits the article.



Do not stuff keywords.



Do not add fake facts, fake statistics, or unsupported claims.



Do not turn informational articles into hard sales pages.



Do not submit generic AI-written filler. AI tools may be used for drafting, but the final work must be useful, edited, readable, and specific to the article.



Do not add irrelevant internal links just to hit a number.



Do not change the site’s strategy. The strategy is already defined: Pinterest traffic, cleaning articles, free checklists, paid planner, and product recommendations.



Skills Required



The ideal candidate should have experience with:



WordPress post editing

Basic SEO content optimization

Internal linking

Blog post formatting

Pinterest-friendly content structure

Strong English writing and editing

Cleaning, home, lifestyle, or organizing content

Creating practical checklist-style content

Following detailed instructions



Experience with Pinterest is helpful, but this is not primarily a Pinterest pin design job. The main work is optimizing the articles so Pinterest traffic has somewhere useful and monetizable to land.



Trial Assignment



The first step will be a paid trial assignment.



You will optimize one existing article and submit the revised version for review.



For the trial, you must provide:



Revised article title

Revised introduction

Improved article outline or structure

Added checklist section

Suggested internal links

Free checklist CTA

Paid planner CTA

Suggested WordPress category

Suggested SEO title and meta description

3-5 Pinterest pin title ideas



You may submit the trial in Google Docs or as a WordPress draft, but do not publish it without approval.



Trial Evaluation



Your trial will be judged on:



Whether the new title fits SimpleCleanHome and Pinterest

Whether the intro connects clearly to a cleaning/home problem

Whether the article is more useful than before

Whether the checklist is practical and save-worthy

Whether internal links are relevant

Whether the free checklist CTA is placed naturally

Whether the paid planner CTA is soft and appropriate

Whether the formatting is clean

Whether you followed instructions

Whether the work feels human-edited and not generic AI filler



Automatic fail if you change the URL without permission, add broken links, ignore the funnel, submit vague filler, or do not follow the checklist.



First Batch of Work



After the trial, the first batch will likely include 5-10 priority articles related to:



bathroom cleaning

floor cleaning

mop alternatives

dust-proofing

refrigerator cleaning

home odor removal

odor eliminator sprays

home scents

laundry odor removal

weekly cleaning routines



The goal is not to optimize every article immediately. The goal is to make the most important articles Pinterest-ready and funnel-ready first.



Estimated Time Per Article



Light cleanup: 45-75 minutes

Standard optimization: 1.5-2.5 hours

Heavy rewrite/reframe: 2.5-4 hours

Product/affiliate post: 2-4 hours



Please include your estimate for how long it would take you to optimize a 1,000-1,500 word article.



How to Apply



Please reply with:



Your hourly rate

Your experience with WordPress

Your experience optimizing blog posts

Your experience with Pinterest-style content

One example of a blog post you improved or optimized

How long it usually takes you to optimize one article

Whether you are comfortable following a detailed checklist

Whether you understand that URLs should not be changed unless approved

The phrase “Pinterest funnel ready” so I know you read this carefully



Applications that do not include the phrase “Pinterest funnel ready” will not be considered.



Budget



This project is budget-conscious. I am looking for someone efficient, reliable, and able to follow instructions carefully.



I prefer to start with a paid trial, then continue with small article batches if the work is good.



Possible structure:



Paid trial: 1 article

First batch: 5 articles

Second batch: 5 articles

title: Web Developer (WordPress + CMS Expert)
description:
About DCB Digital

We're a Brisbane-based digital marketing agency working with professional services and trades businesses across Australia. We specialise in SEO, web design, paid ads, and social media, and we hold ourselves to a high standard across all of it.

We build fully custom WordPress websites. No templates, no shortcuts, no two sites that look the same. Every site we deliver is built to convert, perform, and reflect the business behind it.

We're not trying to be average. We want to be the best at what we do, and everyone on the team plays a part in that.



What this role is

This is not a task-taker role. We need someone who leads the web function, takes full ownership of every project from brief to launch, and makes smart decisions about what goes on a website and why.

You'll work closely with the SEO team when needed, but you're not waiting to be told what to do. You understand how a website should be structured, what content belongs where, and what it takes to make a site that actually performs. You take the brief, you run with it, and you deliver something you're proud of.

We have projects ready to go right now. You won't be sitting around waiting for work to come in.

If you need constant direction, this isn't the right fit. If you're the kind of person who reads a brief, asks the right questions upfront, and then owns the outcome end to end, keep reading.



What you'll be doing



Leading WordPress website builds end to end, from brief through to launch

Taking ownership of what goes on every page, how it's structured, and how it reads

Collaborating with the SEO team when needed to ensure sites are built to perform in search

Implementing and styling content accurately, with a critical eye for quality

Converting Figma designs into responsive, pixel-accurate web pages

Carrying out technical SEO fixes including site speed, mobile responsiveness, and site health

Quality checking every website before and after launch, including cross-browser testing, mobile view, formatting, and functionality

Troubleshooting bugs and resolving issues quickly

Flagging problems early rather than waiting to be asked





What we're looking for



Minimum 3 years experience in WordPress development with a portfolio of live sites to show for it

Someone who can lead a project, not just execute tasks

Strong across Elementor, Breakdance, and Bricks

Solid HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP skills

Comfortable working from Figma files and bringing designs to life accurately

A design eye, you notice when something looks wrong and you fix it

Understanding of technical SEO fundamentals and Core Web Vitals

Experience quality checking live websites, not just builds

Fast, reliable, and accountable

Strong written English and clear communication

Self-motivated and able to manage your own workload without being chased





What we expect



95%+ on-time delivery across builds and changes

Bugs resolved within 48 hours of being reported

PageSpeed score of 80+ on all new builds

100% mobile responsiveness tested and confirmed pre-launch

SEO team requests implemented within 72 hours

Zero critical issues post-launch





What we offer



$10 AUD per hour to start, with performance bonus on top

Full-time, fully remote

Flexible working hours with some overlap with Brisbane business hours preferred

Immediate work available, with a strong and growing pipeline of website projects

A long-term role with real room to grow. As DCB scales, so does the opportunity for the right person

Work that matters. Our clients are established businesses who take their digital presence seriously, and so do we

Clear expectations, honest feedback, and a team that holds itself to a high standard





How we work

We use ClickUp for task management, Google Drive for files, and Slack for comms. Briefs are clear, expectations are set upfront, and we don't micromanage. What we do expect is ownership, accountability, and someone who communicates proactively when something needs attention.



To apply

Apply via OnlineJobs.ph. In your message, include the code word "built to convert", tell us why you want to work with DCB Digital specifically, and send through your portfolio with links to live WordPress websites you've built. Applications without all three will not be considered.

description:
Graphic Designer / AI Static Ad Production Specialist



We're an established meta ads marketing agency looking for a high-volume Graphic Designer / AI Static Ad Production Specialist who can create direct-response static ad creatives for paid social campaigns.



This is not a slow branding role. This is a fast-paced, production-based creative role for someone who can move quickly, follow briefs, use AI tools, and produce a high volume of clean, usable ad creatives every day.



We work with fast-growing brands and move quickly as a team. We care deeply about client results, clear communication, strong execution, and high standards. We want someone who takes ownership of their work, stays organized, communicates proactively, and does not wait to be told what to do when something is unclear or needs to be fixed.



You will be responsible for producing 100 static ad creatives per day, Monday through Friday, using assigned briefs, templates, hooks, offers, client assets, and creative direction.



We use Asana for project management and Slack for daily team communication.



What You’ll Do



In this role, you will create high-volume static ad creatives for
 and Instagram campaigns. Your work will be used for direct-response testing, so the goal is not just to make things look good. The goal is to create clean, readable, launch-ready ads that clearly communicate the hook, offer, and message.



You will be expected to:



•Create 100 static ad creatives per day.



•Design
 and Instagram static ads.



•Use AI tools to speed up creative production.



•Follow assigned creative briefs inside Asana.



•Create variations of hooks, headlines, offers, layouts, and visual concepts.



•Organize files by client, campaign, date, and angle.



•Communicate daily progress, blockers, and completed work in Slack.



•Make revisions quickly based on feedback.



•Maintain a high standard of usable, launch-ready creative.



•Work collaboratively with creative strategists, media buyers, and account managers.



•Pay attention to what is being tested and why, so creative output improves over time.



What We’re Looking For



We’re looking for someone who is fast, organized, creative, coachable, and comfortable with high-volume production.



You do not need to be the world’s fanciest designer. You do need to be reliable, detail-oriented, and able to create ads that are clear enough to test. You should understand that paid social creative needs to sell, not just look pretty.



You should have experience with:



Area

What We Expect

Design tools

Canva, Photoshop, Figma, or similar tools.



AI creative tools

ChatGPT, Midjourney, Higgsfield, OpenAI image tools, or similar.



Paid social creative

Experience creating
 and Instagram static ad creatives.



Direct-response design

Ability to create ads with clear hooks, strong hierarchy, readable text, and obvious offers.



Workflow tools

Comfortable working inside Asana and Slack.



High-volume production

Ability to produce many variations quickly without becoming disorganized.





Strong English communication is important because this role requires clear written updates, feedback loops, and daily coordination with the team.



Key Metrics



This role is measured by simple production and quality numbers. We care about speed, but we also care about accuracy, organization, and whether the creative is actually usable.





Daily production volume

100 statics per day

You are expected to produce 100 completed static ad creatives per workday, Monday through Friday.



Weekly output

500 statics per week

Your weekly production goal is 500 completed static ad creatives.



QA pass rate

90%+

At least 90% of submitted creatives should pass our internal QA scorecard.



QA includes things like correct offer, correct client or brand, correct dimensions, clear visual hierarchy, no spelling errors, proper file naming, organized folders, and whether the creative follows the assigned brief.



What We Care About Most



We want someone who takes ownership.



If something is unclear, you ask. If something breaks, you communicate. If a brief is missing something important, you flag it instead of guessing silently. If feedback is given, you apply it quickly and improve the next batch.



We move fast, expect high standards, and care deeply about client results. The right person for this role is calm under pressure, organized in their workflow, and able to keep producing without letting quality fall apart.



This role is a good fit for someone who is dependable, detail-oriented, and comfortable being measured by output. We are looking for someone who can become a reliable part of the creative production system, not someone who needs constant reminders or hand-holding.



This Role Is a Good Fit If You



•Like fast-paced creative production.



•Are comfortable using AI tools.



•Can follow directions without needing constant reminders.



•Understand that ads need to sell, not just look pretty.



•Can create lots of variations quickly.



•Stay organized across clients, folders, files, and deadlines.



•Communicate clearly in Slack.



•Take feedback well and apply it quickly.



•Can consistently hit daily output goals.



•Stay calm under pressure.



•Take ownership when something is unclear, missing, or needs to be fixed.



This Role Is Not a Good Fit If You



•Prefer slow branding projects.



•Need several hours to make one design.



•Dislike AI tools.



•Struggle with organization.



•Do not like being measured by output.



•Disappear during work hours.



•Get defensive about feedback.



•Cannot consistently follow briefs.



•Need constant reminders to complete assigned work.



•Are uncomfortable with fast-paced agency-style work.



Work Schedule

title: Autocad Template and documentation specialist
description:
AutoCAD Template & Documentation Specialist (Contract Project)



I am an Australian interior designer looking for an experienced AutoCAD specialist to refine and rebuild my existing documentation template into a professional, efficient, and scalable system.



I already have a basic template in place. The goal is to improve and standardise the system rather than start from scratch. A good understanding of Joinery and residential plans and elevations will ensure the outcome is efficient. 



This is initially a one-time project. However, for the right candidate, there may be opportunities for ongoing drafting and documentation work on residential interior design and custom joinery projects.



Scope of Work



• Refine and rebuild AutoCAD template (.DWT)

• Create and organise layer standards

• Set up annotative text, dimensions, and multileader styles

• Establish lineweight and plotting standards

• Configure layouts, viewports, and sheet setups

• Create or improve plot styles (CTB/STB)

• Design an updated title block and sheet layout system

• Set up standard notes, legends, and schedules

• Review and improve overall documentation workflow



Block Management



A key part of this project is creating a clean and organised block library.



I have accumulated blocks from various sources over many years, and I need someone who understands how to clean, rebuild, and standardise blocks so they work correctly within a controlled layer system. Experience managing nested blocks, layer standards, and imported block content is essential.



Requirements



• Advanced AutoCAD expertise

• Strong understanding of CAD standards and documentation systems

• Experience creating professional AutoCAD templates

• Excellent knowledge of annotative scaling

• Strong understanding of blocks, dynamic blocks, and layer management

• Experience with plotting, viewports, layouts, and title blocks

• Strong attention to detail and documentation presentation

Have a sharp graphic sense to design attractive title blocks and cover pages



Bonus



• Interior design documentation experience

• Joinery documentation experience

• Residential construction documentation

• Familiarity with Australian drafting standards



Please provide examples of AutoCAD templates, residential drawings CAD standards, or documentation systems you have developed, along with a brief explanation of your experience.

title: Video Editing Virtual Assistant / Social Media Manager (CapCut + Viral Content Duplication Role)
description:
Video Editing Virtual Assistant / Social Media Manager (CapCut + Viral Content Duplication Role)

(Full-Time · High Output Role · Long-Term Opportunity)

Big opportunity for serious growth-minded people



Starting Salary: $400–$500+ /month depending on skillset

Rapid Growth Potential: $1,000–$2,000+/month based on performance and value

Hours: Full-Time, UK Time Zone (Flexible within UK hours)





We are looking for a proactive Video Editing Virtual Assistant / Social Media Manager who understands CapCut, short-form content, hooks, social media psychology, and marketing thinking.



This is a virtual assistant, social media management, and video editing role for somebody who is hungry, ambitious, creative, and looking to become part of a serious team environment with huge growth potential.



We want somebody who genuinely wants to grow with us long-term and become part of a team that truly cares about growth, creativity, performance, and helping each other succeed.



This role is mainly focused on producing a HIGH volume of simple short-form videos quickly and efficiently.



90% of the role will be video editing.

10% of the role will involve helping us with marketing-related tasks, research, social media thinking, and creative ideas.



We are NOT looking for somebody who edits slowly or overcomplicates things.



We want somebody who is proactive, fast, organised, and goal-driven — somebody who wants to make as many strong videos as possible every hour while constantly thinking about hooks, duplication strategies, virality, and how content can perform better.



We need somebody who can understand:



Hook psychology

Viral short-form content

Marketing thinking

Social media behaviour

Attention spans

Duplication systems

Speed and consistency

We want somebody who can almost act as a social media marketing manager while editing content — somebody who understands WHY videos perform and constantly comes up with new ideas, hooks, angles, and strategies.



This is a highly rewarding long-term role where your salary and opportunities will grow based on the performance, creativity, speed, and value you bring to the company.



The more we grow, the more we want YOU to grow.



???? If your plan is to clock in, clock out, and do the bare minimum — this is NOT the role for you.

We are only looking for serious growth-minded people who genuinely want to become part of a fast-growing team and contribute long-term.



???? The Workflow (Very Simple Once Understood)

For example:

We may give you one raw footage clip showing a paint colour.



Your job is to:



Add a strong hook caption onto the video

Add the brand name + colour name

Create a clean simple edit

Duplicate the same video multiple times

Change the colour name in the caption

Change the background footage slightly

Repeat this for every colour variation

For example:

If one brand has 20 colours, you can quickly duplicate the same structure across every colour variation.



Then we repeat the same process again using different hooks and different marketing angles.



This allows us to create large amounts of content quickly and test multiple viral hooks at scale.



The more content we test, the higher the chance we go viral.



???? Example Process (How We Want You To Work)

We want somebody who can work FAST and intelligently.



For example:



Take 1 raw clip

Add 1 strong hook

Duplicate the same video 20–30 times

Change the colour name

Slightly change footage/background

Export quickly

Repeat with another hook angle

This means in around 30 minutes to 1 hour, you should be capable of producing LARGE amounts of content variations efficiently.



This is NOT about spending hours over-editing one video.



This is about:



Volume

Hooks

Marketing thinking

Speed

Duplication

Testing angles

Viral potential

???? Examples Of Hook Ideas

We need somebody constantly researching and testing new hook ideas such as:



“Designer colours without the designer prices”

“This colour completely changed the room”

“Luxury paint colours on a budget”

“The easiest way to modernise your walls”

“This colour makes your room look expensive”

“POV: You finally found the perfect shade”

“Interior designers are obsessed with this colour”

“Nobody talks about this paint colour enough”

“This colour trend is going viral for a reason”

“The simplest way to upgrade your home”

We want somebody who constantly thinks:



“What hook would make somebody STOP scrolling?”



???? What You Will Be Responsible For:

Editing multiple short-form videos every single day

Researching powerful hooks and viral caption ideas

Finding and testing video editing AI tools and workflows

Creating and editing social media video responses

Helping brainstorm script ideas and viral content concepts

Duplicating content variations efficiently

Changing backgrounds, hooks, colours, and visual variations quickly

Helping improve workflows and content systems

Supporting the team with social media and marketing tasks when needed

Bringing fresh ideas and marketing angles constantly

We want somebody who thinks:



“How can we make MORE videos, FASTER, while still making them engaging?”

Knows CapCut very well

Understands TikTok/Reels editing styles

Understands hook psychology and social media marketing

Able to follow instructions and deep detail properly

Fast worker who utilises time effectively

Long-term mindset — not just another editing job

We are looking for somebody who gets excited about helping build something big.

Performance-based bonuses

Rapid salary increases

Long-term opportunities inside the company

The role starts at 20 hours/week and is expected to grow to full-time as trust builds and more tasks are handed over — particularly from one of the directors who is aiming for a 4-day work week within a few months of the VA starting.

Social Media & Content



Own Instagram and

Instagram,
, Meta Business Suite — confident, independent operator

- Design systems that are secure, maintainable, debuggable, and understandable to future engineers

- Separate prompt/configuration, business rules, validation, logging, and UI-facing status clearly

- Communicate tradeoffs and ask good questions when requirements are ambiguous



## Required Experience



You should have:



- Experience building and maintaining real production software applications

- Full-stack product engineering ability across frontend, backend, APIs, databases, and deployment workflows

Remote Survey Programmer — Voxco / JavaScript Specialist (Market Research)

Employer: TKW Research Group (Australia / New Zealand)

Location: Remote — Philippines

Engagement: Independent contractor, full-time equivalent (approx. 40 hrs/week)



The Package — What You’ll Receive



TKW Research Group is a long-standing Australian/New Zealand market research firm, and we’re looking for a Survey Programmer to join us on a long-term contract basis. This is a real partnership, not a transactional gig — and a chance to contribute to something genuinely new in market research. The package reflects that:



• Front-row seat on a voicebot R&D project — you’ll contribute directly to a survey voicebot we’re developing with a tier-1 AI platform partner. Real conversational-AI exposure on your CV.



• Base retainer: ?90,000 – ?140,000 PHP per month, commensurate with experience and voicebot project involvement, paid in arrears.



• 13th-month service bonus equivalent to one month’s base fee, paid every December.

• HMO allowance of up to ?50,000 per year, fully reimbursing premium private health cover for you and one dependent.

• Internet & equipment stipend of ?3,000 per month to support your home office setup.

• 10 days of paid leave per annum after 12 months of service, plus observed Australian public holidays without reduction to your base fee.



• Full training paid by TKW Research Group — structured onboarding plus ongoing platform training (Voxco and related tools) so you can perform at the highest level.



• Direct relationship with senior project managers in Australia/New Zealand — no middle layers, no agency markup.



About the Role



We’re looking for a Survey Programmer who can take complex questionnaires and turn them into clean, well-tested, production-ready survey scripts. You’ll own the scripting pipeline end-to-end: build, test, launch, deliver data.



Direct experience with Voxco is ideal, but we’re equally open to strong programmers from Forsta/Confirmit, Decipher, or Qualtrics who can pick up Voxco quickly — and we’ll fund the training to get you there. What matters more is that you can write real JavaScript (not just drag-and-drop survey builder logic) and that you sweat the details on QA.



The Voicebot Project — What Makes This Different



Alongside your core scripting work, you’ll contribute to something most survey programmers never get to touch: TKW Research Group is partnering with a tier-1 multinational AI platform provider to develop a survey voicebot — conversational AI that conducts genuine, natural-sounding interviews at scale.



Your role on the project: building the underlying survey logic, question structures, routing, and validation rules that the voicebot will run. You’re not expected to be an ML engineer — you’re the survey expert who makes sure the conversational layer asks the right questions in the right order and captures clean data on the other side.



This is genuine R&D work with commercial backing. You’ll be one of a handful of survey programmers globally with hands-on conversational-AI experience on your CV.



What You’ll Do

• Translate questionnaires (Word, PDF, client-supplied) into interactive online and CATI scripts.

• Build complex logic: skip patterns, routing, piping, randomisation, quota management, custom validations.

• Write JavaScript, HTML5 and CSS3 to extend platform functionality where the out-of-the-box tools fall short.

• Test thoroughly — logic, edge cases, mobile rendering, accessibility — before anything goes live.

• Export and format data (SPSS, CSV, Excel) for the analysis team.



What We’re Looking For

• 3+ years programming surveys in a market research agency, fieldwork house, or specialised BPO.

• Strong JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3 — you should be comfortable debugging in browser dev tools.

• Hands-on experience with at least one enterprise platform: Voxco, Forsta/Confirmit, Decipher, or Qualtrics.

• Bonus points for SPSS syntax, Python, SQL, or experience with conjoint/MaxDiff modules.

• Genuine interest in conversational AI — you don’t need ML experience, but you should be curious about how survey methodology and voice AI intersect.

• Reliable home office: high-spec PC, dual monitors preferred, stable internet plus a backup option.

• Strong written English — you’ll be communicating with project managers in Australia and New Zealand.



How to Apply



Send your CV plus a short note covering:

1. The platforms you’ve worked on.

2. The most complex script you’ve built.

3. Your earliest available start date.

4. A sentence or two on why the voicebot project interests you.

?

title: Video Editor – Shorts, Long-Form & Trailers DaVinci Resolve

nts that will hit

nts

 subject line:

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant

We’re on the lookout for an Accounts Assistant to join our expanding team.  



A Bit About HeadBox

At HeadBox, our purpose is simple. We connect people and spaces to make brilliant things happen.

But it's not always been straightforward to hire or host at an amazing venue. In fact, prior to the company's inception in 2015, it was the exact opposite. Our business was born from frustration at the outdated, slow, inefficient and time-consuming venue booking process that anyone looking to book a space had to endure.

Since then, we've uncovered more challenges faced by corporates, venue managers and people looking for venue space but our purpose has always remained the same. We've spent the last few years becoming obsessed with our customers and their problems so that we can build products, tools and features to make their lives easier. Think of it as human-kind event-tech. Our ecosystem of products make event and venue management simple, secure and transparent, whether you want to hire a space or host an event.

HeadBox Australia launched in 2020 led by Ali Lord, ex-Head of Events at Dentsu Aegis UK. In her previous role, Ali was one of the early adopters of the HeadBox Business technology and experienced first hand the benefits and efficiencies it provides corporations. Ali quickly knew this was a product she had to bring back to Australia.

HeadBox are now in the process of taking Australia by storm and are looking for a new tea
mber to join us on this exciting journey.



About You

You can hit the ground running, ideally holding a Bachelor’s degree in Accountancy or related professional qualification with at least 2 years of experience in a similar role with demonstrated skills and abilities.. 

You have hands-on experience and good understanding of using Xero accounting software. 

It would be advantageous for you to hold knowledge of the Australian taxation and accounting system. 

You’re highly organised, detail-oriented, and can work well under pressure. You have a strong work ethic, a curiosity for learning, and a desire to contribute to our collective success.



The Role

The Accounts Assistant is primarily responsible for Accounts Receivables, Accounts Payable and Bookkeeping functions across the business. Reporting to the Finance Officer, this role has a wealth of variety on offer as you’ll be exposed to all areas of the business as new customers join and the teams win new business. 



Key Responsibilities



- Accounts Receivable & Payable

- Prepare and issue invoices to HeadBox clients in consultation with the business development, customer success and event planning and event management tea
mbers. 

- Manage overdue invoices and follow up on outstanding payments.

- Reconcile bank transactions and accounts.

- Process and code supplier invoices accurately.

- Assist with month-end and year-end reconciliations.

- Support the preparation of accurate financial reports and schedules.

- Ensure compliance with accounting and financial reporting standards.



Miscellaneous Support

- Assist the finance and operations team with ad hoc tasks from time to time

- Support the commercial teams with finance-related queries and data.



Requirements 

- Commercial aspiration: a drive and willingness to learn the key commercial skills required to be a competent commercial tea
mber.

- Communication: it is important that you have strong interpersonal and communication skills as you will be interacting with clients and you will be required to tailor your communication appropriately to the right person. 

- Attention to detail: goes without saying really, but nothing goes unnoticed by you. You're risk-averse and your accounting is meticulous, accurate and consistent. You like to get it done the right way the first time around. Big picture thinking is essential.

- Be great to work with: we’re looking for someone who embodies the HeadBox values of brilliance, integrity, empathy, curiosity. We need someone independent, flexible, adaptable and ready to get stuck-in. 

- Growth mindset: you love staying abreast of the latest tools, techniques and equipment in your area of focus and you're happy to share your intel with the team.

- Loyalty: we're big on people who get what we do, why we're doing it and those who genuinely want to be part of something that is shaking up markets that are steeped in old-fashioned ways. You're in it for the long haul, just like the rest of the crew.



Toolbox

Experience in the following is highly desirable as you will be using these tools to do your job:

- MS Office (Word, Excel, PPT) AND Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides) - Advance experience

- Xero (Accounting Software) 



In the course of the role, you will also be exposed the other tech tools we use, which include:

- HubDoc (Document Collection & Management Software)

- Stripe (Online Payment Processing Software)

- Hubspot (Customer Relationship Management Software)

- HeadBox (Our own proprietary Software)

title: E-Com Operation Assistant (eBay)
description:
I am looking for a reliable, detail-oriented assistant to help run a small e-commerce store on eBay. The store uses AutoDS for sourcing and listing, so the majority of your work will take place within AutoDS and eBay's Seller Hub.

This is a structured, process-driven position rather than a strategic one. A detailed standard operating procedure (SOP) is in place that specifies exactly how each task should be performed. Your responsibility is to execute that process accurately and consistently, escalate anything unusual to me, and keep daily operations running smoothly. Strong performance in this role opens the door to expanded hours, increased pay, and greater responsibility as the store grows.



Responsibilities:

Product listing (via AutoDS): Source and list approximately 50-60 products per working day in line with the SOP, verifying reviews, pricing, supplier shipping speed, and brand-safety criteria before each listing.

Daily order management: Review the AutoDS orders dashboard each working day to identify and resolve any failed or pending orders according to the SOP. This is the single most important daily task.

Customer service: Respond to buyer messages within 24 hours using available listing information. When a question cannot be answered confidently, escalate it to me — accuracy is valued over guesswork.

Disputes and returns: Resolve straightforward "item not received" cases by uploading tracking; escalate all other case types to me.

Buyer offers: Send daily offers to new watchers in accordance with the SOP.

Store maintenance: Monitor stock levels, document out-of-stock items, and complete the monthly listing review and cleanup.

Weekly reporting: Provide a brief weekly summary of store health (defects, late shipments, open cases) and attend a short weekly check-in call.



Required Qualifications:

Reliability and consistency — dependable daily attendance and completion of the daily order check without prompting. This is the most important quality for the role.

Strong attention to detail — the ability to follow a checklist precisely, particularly the pricing and brand-safety rules.

Proficient written English — you will communicate directly with buyers.

Adaptability with tools — prior experience with AutoDS and/or eBay is a strong advantage, though the right candidate who learns quickly will be trained.

Integrity — a willingness to flag problems early rather than conceal them.



Preferred Qualifications:

Prior eBay or e-commerce virtual assistant experience

Familiarity with AutoDS or comparable listing and automation tools

Working knowledge of spreadsheets (Google Sheets or Excel)



Flexible Scheduling is offered, will discuss more upon interview!

title: Junior or Senior Video Editor
description:
*** Please read the entire post before applying. Thanks! ***



*** About the Role ***



If you want editing work that actually matters, this is it!



Engage Video Production (EVP) creates educational and communication-focused video for aerospace, defense, and other technical clients. You will help turn complex subjects into something clear and usable, whether that means explaining how satellites stay in orbit, helping engineers communicate their work, or building training content people can actually follow. The work is structured and built for real-world use, not just visuals.



This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week role working directly with the Creative Director. Projects range from short explainers to long-form training content. Aerospace and defense are our core specialties, but our projects vary widely, so we need an editor who is adaptable, technically proficient, and comfortable shifting styles to fit each client's goals.



If you need reminders to respond or follow up, this is not a fit. If you spot issues early, communicate clearly, and take ownership of your work, keep reading.



*** The Three Pillars of Success at EVP ***



To succeed here, you need to live these three values:



Discipline: You follow through on every task without floundering or ghosting. You manage your time and meet deadlines without constant supervision.



Ownership / Initiative: You do more than complete tasks. You look for ways to improve the work and support the team.



Integrity / Accountability: You own your mistakes right away. You have the backbone to point out errors for correction, even your own, because precision here is non-negotiable.



*** Role Overview ***



You will execute the editing of active projects under the guidance of our Creative Director. Aside from syncs and updates to align on priorities, you work independently. You are responsible for your output, your timeline, and how you communicate progress.



The ideal candidate works independently on assigned tasks, manages large volumes of data, and communicates proactively. You take pride in technical accuracy and understand how a project's storytelling drives results for the client.



*** Core Responsibilities ***



Video Editing: Edit short- and long-form content from start to finish, with strong storytelling and pacing on every project.



Media Management: Organize, sync, and manage large volumes of footage. You must be comfortable with projects ranging from hundreds of gigabytes to multiple terabytes.



Technical Finishing: Perform professional color correction and grading on all deliverables, including RAW workflows, and keep visual consistency.



Audio and Sound Design: Integrate music, handle basic audio cleanup and mixing, and make sure sound design fits the project's goals.



Graphics: Apply motion graphics, titles, and lower thirds as the project requires, for a polished, professional product.



Feedback and Coordination: Implement revisions efficiently and meet agreed deadlines. You will coordinate daily with the Creative Director and, when applicable, other editors or freelancers.



Communication: This is part of the job, not an extra. Send progress updates as needed, flag blockers early and suggest solutions, and stay aligned with the Creative Director and company priorities. Silent work does not fly here.



*** Required Qualifications ***



Professional Background: Real experience in video editing (freelance or agency), with a solid grasp of pacing, storytelling, and professional delivery formats.



Software: High proficiency in DaVinci Resolve or Adobe Premiere Pro. Resolve is our preferred NLE, but we welcome expert Premiere editors who deliver professional results.



Technical Foundations: Strong audio cleanup and mixing, plus color correction and grading workflows.



RAW Workflow (Preferred): Experience editing and grading RED RAW footage. If you have not handled RED RAW, you must be a fast learner who can manage complex, high-resolution media.



Data and Infrastructure: A reliable, high-speed internet connection is non-negotiable. You will regularly receive hundreds of gigabytes to terabytes of footage and must be comfortable managing that volume.



Autonomy and Communication: Excellent written English and a proactive approach to reporting. You work without micromanagement and stay vocal about timelines, challenges, and progress.



*** Bonus / Preferred Skills ***



- Motion graphics (Fusion, After Effects, or similar)

- Graphic design for diagrams or visual explainers

- Experience with technical, educational, or corporate content

- Familiarity with 
 or structured feedback workflows

- Interest in aerospace, defense, or technical subjects



*** Compensation ***



Hourly Rate: $4.00 to $10.00 USD per hour. Your starting rate depends on experience and demonstrated skill.

This is a full-time role and full-time is what we are after. That said, if you are clearly qualified but can only commit part-time right now, apply anyway and tell us your availability.



Full-Time (40 hrs/week): $640 to $1,600 USD per month (about 39,000 to 98,000 PHP).

Part-Time (20 hrs/week): $320 to $800 USD per month (about 20,000 to 49,000 PHP).

[*Conversions are approximate.]



*** A Note on AI and Judgment ***



At EVP, we use advanced tools every day. But this role requires real human judgment and radical integrity. We are hiring a human, not a prompt.



If you use AI to draft your personal responses in the "How to Apply" section, you fail the first test of this role: honesty. We want your real thoughts and your real personality so we can tell whether you fit our team. If your application has no genuine human voice, it will be discarded.
