*** About the Role ***



If you want motion graphics video work that actually matters, this is it!



Engage Video Production (EVP) creates educational and communication-focused video for aerospace, defense, and other technical clients. You will be our primary creator for explainer and motion graphics videos, and the internal design resource that keeps every project sharp, from animated explainers to the diagrams, callouts, and overlays our editors rely on. The work is structured and built for real-world use, not just visuals.



This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week role working directly with the Creative Director. Aerospace and defense are our core specialties, but our projects vary widely, so we need a designer who is adaptable, technically proficient, and comfortable shifting styles to fit each client's goals.



If you need reminders to respond or follow up, this is not a fit. If you spot issues early, communicate clearly, and take ownership of your work, keep reading.



*** The Three Pillars of Success at EVP ***



To succeed here, you need to live these three values:



Discipline: You follow through on every task without floundering or ghosting. You manage your time and meet deadlines without constant supervision.



Ownership / Initiative: You do more than complete tasks. You look for ways to improve the work and support the team.

Integrity / Accountability: You own your mistakes right away. You have the backbone to point out errors for correction, even your own, because precision here is non-negotiable.



*** Role Overview ***



This is a dual-focus role. You are the primary creator for our explainer and motion graphics videos, and you also produce graphic assets for our standard video team when needed. You will coordinate with our editors to supply the graphic elements, overlays, and design assets each project needs.



*** Core Responsibilities ***



Motion Graphics: Lead the production of full explainer videos, from storyboarding and asset creation to final animation.

Brand Consistency: Hold a high level of quality across every visual touchpoint, with a clean, professional, and sophisticated look.



Communication: This is part of the job, not an extra. Send progress updates as needed, flag blockers early and suggest solutions, and stay aligned with the Creative Director and company priorities. Silent work does not fly here.

Job Type: Part Time, Work From Home, Long Term



Hours: 10 hours per week to start with opportunity to grow to 20 or more hours per week based on performance



Pay Rate: $4.00 USD per hour paid weekly via PayPal



About This Role



We are a professional services company based in Los Angeles, California run by Dr. Robert Jaffe, a licensed professional with over 40 years of experience working with businesses and professionals across the United States.



We are looking for a reliable, detail oriented, and warm natured Virtual Assistant to join our small team on a part time basis with the potential to grow into a full time long term position for the right person.



This is not a complicated technical role. Everything you need to do comes with a clear step by step written script and training. If you can follow instructions carefully, communicate professionally in English, and take pride in doing your work thoroughly and on time, you will do very well in this position.



What You Will Be Doing



Your primary job is to reach out to local businesses in the United States that do not yet have a website and introduce them to a professional website we have already built for them at no charge. You will do this using
, text message, and
 direct message following a script we provide.



When a business owner responds positively and claims their website, you will send them a warm welcome message, conduct a brief follow up phone or video call using a script we provide, collect some information from them to personalize their site, and introduce them to our additional services.



You will also keep a detailed tracking sheet updated in real time so our team always knows exactly where every client and every outreach attempt stands.



Specific daily tasks include the following.



Using our lead finding software to identify local businesses without websites. Building professional websites for those businesses using our AI website builder. Sending outreach messages via
, text, and
 following our provided scripts. Responding to interested business owners promptly and professionally. Conducting brief follow up calls using our provided call script. Completing a client intake form during each follow up call. Sending follow up information to interested clients. Keeping the tracking sheet updated after every action.



What We Are Looking For



You must have excellent written and spoken English. Your
s and messages will represent Dr. Jaffe's professional brand and must be warm, clear, and professional at all times.

You must have a stable internet connection and a quiet place to work and make calls.

Experience with virtual assistance, customer service, outreach, or sales support is preferred but not required. We will train the right person from scratch.



What We Offer



A starting rate of $4.00 USD per hour paid weekly via PayPal every Friday.



A consistent and predictable part time schedule of 10 hours per week to start.



Clear written scripts and instructions for every task so you are never guessing what to do.



A supportive and respectful working relationship with Dr. Jaffe's team.



Real opportunity to grow your hours and your responsibilities as the business grows. We are looking for someone who wants to build a long term working relationship, not just fill a short term contract.



How To Apply



Please send the following three things in your application.



First, a brief introduction of yourself in your own words telling us who you are, what your work experience has been, and why this role appeals to you.



Second, a short recorded voice or video message of no more than two minutes introducing yourself as if you were calling an American business owner for the first time. You can record this on your phone and send the file or a link. This is the single most important part of your application because your phone manner is central to this role.



Third, your availability, meaning which days and hours you are available to work and what time zone you are in.



Applications without all three components will not be considered. We look forward to hearing from you.

title: STR Bookkeeper
description:
We run a short-term rental business with 9 furnished homes and are looking for a reliable bookkeeper to clean up our recent books and handle ongoing monthly bookkeeping.  This will start with a cleanup of the last 2–3 months, then transition into ongoing monthly work.  This is a long-term role for someone who is detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable working with multiple properties.



Initial Work (Cleanup):

-Clean up and organize the last 2–3 months in QuickBooks Online

-We track bookings, revenue, cleaning fees, and owner payouts in Excel, and this will need to be matched and reconciled to QBO

-Reconcile bank and credit card accounts

-Fix and organize transaction categorization

-Match Airbnb/booking platform payouts to reservations

-Confirm owner payouts are correct for each property

-Flag any missing or duplicate transactions

-Prepare clean monthly Profit & Loss statements



Ongoing Monthly Work:

-Monthly bookkeeping in QuickBooks Online

-Bank and credit card reconciliations

-Categorize income and expenses (Airbnb, Vrbo, direct bookings, utilities, maintenance, supplies, etc.)

-Track cleaning fees and vendor payments

-Record and verify owner payouts per property

-Provide monthly P&L reports (per property)

-Keep books fully up to date each month



What We’re Looking For:

-Strong QuickBooks Online experience

-Experience with Airbnb / short-term rentals

-Very detail-oriented and organized

-Clear communication and responsive

-Comfortable with multiple properties

-Proactive and able to spot issues, not just enter data

title: Marketing Specialist/ Digital Marketer/CMO/Marketing Manager
description:
We are the Graham Group, a top-producing real estate team with eXp Realty based in Birmingham, Alabama. Since 2012 we've built one of the most successful teams in our market — multiple-time eXp ICON Award winners, $40M+ in annual production, and trainers and coaches to 80+ agents nationwide.



We believe great real estate is about trust and systems: showing up like a professional from the first 
nt a consumer meets us, nurturing that relationship over time, and staying connected long after the sale. We're looking for a marketing leader who can build the engine that makes that happen at scale.





THE ROLE



This is not a "post on Instagram" job. You will own the entire marketing function for our team. You'll set the strategy, build the systems, generate leads, manage our content team, and tie every dollar we spend to a measurable result. You'll be the person who makes sure our brand looks elite, our pipeline stays full, and our database never goes cold.



If you're strategic and willing to roll up your sleeves, this is your seat.





WHAT YOU'LL OWN



Strategy & Brand

- Build and execute the team's overall marketing strategy and annual plan.

- Own our brand — voice, look, and consistency across every channel and touchpoint.

- Position the Graham Group as the trusted, go-to authority in our market.



Lead Generation

- Plan, launch, and optimize paid ad campaigns 
, Instagram, Google, YouTube).

- Drive a consistent flow of buyer and seller leads and track cost-per-lead and ROI.

- Develop landing pages, lead magnets, and conversion funnels.



Nurture & Trust Systems (core to who we are)

- Build automated and personal follow-up systems in our CRM that nurture leads from first contact to closing — and beyond.

- Create the "stay-in-touch" and post-close campaigns that turn past clients into repeat and referral business.

- Make every consumer feel like they're working with a true professional at every stage.



Content & Social

- Own the content calendar across YouTube, Instagram,
, TikTok, and
.

- Manage and direct the marketing editor and contractors to produce video, graphics, and listing content on schedule.

- Lead our YouTube and SEO strategy so we get found organically.



Listings & Agent Attraction

- Build a repeatable listing marketing system so every property gets a professional rollout.

- Support agent recruiting and attraction marketing for our growing team.



Analytics

- Track and report on every channel — leads, conversion, engagement, spend, and ROI.

- Use the data to double down on what works and cut what doesn't.





WHAT YOU BRING



- 3+ years of marketing experience with a track record of generating leads and measurable results (real estate or related industry strongly preferred).

- Both strategic thinking and hands-on execution — you can build the plan and do the work.

- Hands-on experience running paid ad campaigns (Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads).

- Experience with a CRM and building
/automation nurture campaigns (Follow Up Boss, kvCore, or similar a plus).

- Strong grasp of social media, content, and SEO.

- Comfort reading data and reporting on ROI.

- Excellent written communication and a sharp eye for brand and design.

- Self-starter who thrives with systems and ownership.





NICE TO HAVE



- Direct real estate marketing experience.

- Experience managing a small team or contractors.

- Video, design, or copywriting skills.

- Familiarity with marketing automation and AI tools.





WHY WORK WITH US



- A proven, successful, growing team that genuinely values marketing.

- Real ownership of a function — your work directly drives the business.

- Performance-based upside tied to the leads and ROI you create.

- A leadership team that lives and breathes systems, training, and growth.





HOW TO APPLY



1. Submit your resume and a short note on a marketing campaign you ran that produced real, measurable results — what you did, and the numbers.

2. Include links to work samples or a portfolio.

3. Start your message with the word "SYSTEMS" so we know you read the full posting.



We're looking for a sharp, accountable marketing leader who wants to build something great with us. We can't wait to meet you.

mbers

Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer

description:

About the Role

SPA Marketing is a growing digital marketing agency specializing in helping local businesses dominate their markets online. We work with clients across a range of industries — from health & wellness to home services — and we're looking for a sharp, results-driven SEO specialist who lives and breathes local search and understands how AI is reshaping the way people discover businesses online.

This is an online, fully remote position. You'll work closely with our strategy team to build and execute local SEO campaigns, optimize for AI-driven search experiences (including Google's AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and similar platforms), and report measurable results to clients. If you know your way around Google Business Profile, citation building, schema markup, and you're genuinely excited about how large language models are changing the search landscape, we want to hear from you.



What You'll Do



Develop and execute local SEO strategies for clients in competitive markets

Optimize Google Business Profiles, manage reviews strategy, and oversee local citation building and cleanup

Conduct keyword research with a focus on local intent, near-me queries, and conversational/voice search patterns

Implement structured data (schema markup) to improve visibility in rich results and AI-generated summaries

Monitor and adapt strategies for AI search surfaces including Google AI Overviews, SGE, Bing Copilot, and LLM-based discovery platforms

Audit and improve on-page SEO, internal linking, and content structure for local relevance

Build and manage location pages, service area content, and geo-targeted landing pages

Track and report on rankings, local pack visibility, GBP insights, organic traffic, and lead generation KPIs

Stay current on Google algorithm updates and evolving AI search behaviors

Collaborate with our content and paid media teams for integrated campaign execution





What We're Looking For

Required Skills & Experience



2+ years of hands-on local SEO experience with demonstrated client results

Deep familiarity with Google Business Profile management and optimization

Experience with citation management platforms (BrightLocal, Whitespark, Yext, or similar)

Strong understanding of technical SEO: schema markup, crawl optimization, Core Web Vitals

Working knowledge of how AI search engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews) surface local results

Proficiency with Google Search Console, GA4, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or Moz

Strong written communication skills — you'll be writing client-facing reports and strategy docs

Ability to manage multiple client accounts simultaneously with strong organizational skills



Bonus Points For



Experience optimizing content to appear in LLM-generated answers (answer engine optimization / AEO)

Familiarity with prompt engineering or AI content workflows

Experience in multi-location SEO or franchise-level campaigns

Understanding of the relationship between local SEO and paid local search (LSAs, Google Ads)

Any experience with reputation management platforms





Our Hiring Process

We receive a high volume of applications for every role we post, and frankly, most of them tell us very little about whether someone will actually perform. Generic cover letters and resume keywords only go so far. What we care about is whether you actually read, pay attention to detail, and can think clearly about SEO — three things that matter enormously in this job.

To make sure we're spending our time on the right candidates, we use a simple filter. Before you apply through any job board, please send a brief
 to 
 with the subject line: "AI Local SEO — I Actually Read This" and in the body, answer the following question in 3–5 sentences: What is one concrete way a local business can improve its chances of being cited or recommended by an AI search engine like ChatGPT or Google's AI Overviews — and why does that tactic work? Applications that skip this step will not be reviewed. This is not optional and it is not a formality — it's the first real test of whether you're a good fit for this team.

Once we receive your
, our team will follow up within 3–5 business days with next steps, which typically include a short async video intro and a paid audit task on a sample client account.



Access to premium SEO and AI tools (we cover your stack)

Ongoing professional development budget for courses, conferences, and certifications

Supportive, small-team culture where your ideas actually get implemented

Performance bonuses tied to client retention and campaign results

description:
Shopify Landing Page Builder & CRO Specialist (Remote / Contract)

About us

Man Cereal is a fast-growing DTC brand. We're looking for a skilled landing page builder to own the design and build of high-converting landing pages on our Shopify store. This is a hands-on role for someone who can take a concept and ship a finished, conversion-optimized page without heavy hand-holding.



What you'll do



Build and launch landing pages on Shopify that are fast, mobile-first, and optimized to convert paid and organic traffic

Own end-to-end execution: wireframe, design, build, QA, publish, and iterate

Translate offers, angles, and copy into clean page layouts that drive add-to-carts and purchases

Set up and run A/B tests, then make data-backed changes based on results

Strong eye for clean, on-brand design and attention to detail

Experience in DTC, food/CPG, or supplements/health verticals

Speed — you can ship a solid page in days, not weeks

POSITION SUMMARY

The Client Concierge Coordinator serves as a pivotal support role for clients attending our Essentials Workshops and other Cardone Ventures events. This individual is responsible for ensuring that every client has a seamless and remarkable experience from the 
nt of purchase through event attendance. The role includes managing communications, conducting welcome calls, coordinating event scheduling, and providing customer service support via
, phone, and other communication channels. This person will proactively handle client needs, such as confirming event attendance, addressing concerns, and upselling additional seats or tickets.



This will be a contract position only of 3-6 months



This position is 100% remote.



ABOUT CARDONE VENTURES

Our mission is to help business owners achieve their personal, professional, and financial goals through the growth of their businesses. We work in dozens of verticals and provide strategic business guidance through courses, live events, partnerships, and investments. Our core values are the backbone of our business and guide our hiring process: we are inspirational, accountable, transparent, disciplined, aligned, and results oriented. This company operates nationally and is growing by the day.



Wondering what it's like to work here? Come check this:


/watch?v=PIIv7sYj1Ns



SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Driving an increase in client engagement and event participation by effectively managing communications and follow-ups to ensure high attendance rates, upselling additional seats or tickets, and maximizing event participation



OBJECTIVES

• Manage post-sale client interactions to confirm ticket payments and ensure attendance at purchased events.

• Audit pre-event task completion and manage reminders to ensure clients are ready for their events.

• Assist the Client Concierge Manager in resolving client concerns, answering queries, and enhancing client satisfaction.

• Facilitate event scheduling, including follow-ups with clients who have not scheduled their attendance and rescheduling as necessary.

• Upsell additional event tickets or seats by effectively using sales scripts tailored to various Cardone Ventures events and workshops.

• Build trust and maintain positive client relationships through open and interactive communication.

• Manage various client communications platforms, including HubSpot, Asana, G-Suite, Slick Text, and Aloware, ensuring timely responses and accurate information sharing.

• Monitor and manage und
 calls and tasks, marketing responses, and communication blasts to drive client engagement.

• Support with scrubbing and managing deals related to 10X360 and Essential Workshops to ensure accurate tracking and client follow-up

• Ensure response times to client inquiries are within a 24-hour window, maintaining a high standard of customer service.



COMPETENCIES

• Proven experience in de-escalating client situations while maintaining a positive representation of the Cardone Ventures brand.

• Proficiency in HubSpot, Asana, and G-Suite tools (Sheets, Documents, Gmail, Calendars, Slides).

• Strong communication skills with the ability to memorize and effectively utilize essential sales scripts.

• High level of business acumen to engage with business owners and understand their needs.

• Capable of executing process improvements to streamline client communications and event coordination.

• Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks, including daily priority meetings, pre-event qualifications, and managing client communications across multiple platforms.



EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

• At least 2 years’ experience in a customer service role in a professional environment



PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

title: Strategic Patient Acquisition Manager – Cardiac Surgery & Medical Tourism (Remote)
description:
Heartline Clinics is developing an international patient acquisition and medical tourism platform focused primarily on cardiac surgery and cardiovascular procedures for patients seeking high-quality care outside their home country.

Our team includes three of the leading cardiac surgeons in the Dominican Republic, supported by a complete cardiovascular surgical team and a fully operational, high-end clinical facility in Santo Domingo.

We provide international patients with a comprehensive turnkey experience, including:

    • Surgical care 

    • Medical coordination 

    • Travel assistance 

    • Accommodations 

    • Transportation 

    • Patient support services 

Our primary focus is patients in the United States and Canada who may be facing:

    • Excessively high surgical costs 

    • Long wait times 

    • Insurance limitations 

    • Delays in accessing treatment 

    • Limited surgical options within their local healthcare system 



Position Overview

This is not a traditional sales role.

We are not seeking telemarketers, boiler-room salespeople, appointment setters, or aggressive cold callers.

This is a highly relationship-driven, trust-based patient acquisition and conversion role requiring intelligence, professionalism, emotional maturity, patience, initiative, and exceptional communication skills.

The primary objective of this position is to identify, engage, nurture, and convert qualified prospective cardiac surgery patients into scheduled consultations and surgical procedures.

We are seeking a highly professional individual with exceptional English communication skills, strong interpersonal abilities, and a warm, trustworthy personality capable of building long-term relationships with patients and families facing serious medical decisions.

The successful candidate must be capable of working independently, exercising sound judgment, and developing patient opportunities through research, networking, relationship-building, and ongoing communication.



Key Responsibilities

The successful candidate will be comfortable and experienced with:

    • Researching and identifying potential patient opportunities online 

    • Developing relationships with prospective patients and their families 

    • Communicating within
 groups, Reddit communities, online forums, patient support groups, expat communities, and medical tourism channels 

    • Developing referral relationships with cardiologists, family physicians, clinics, hospitals, case managers, patient advocates, and healthcare organizations 

    • Identifying strategic referral sources and partnership opportunities 

    • Speaking with physicians, clinics, patient advocacy organizations, and referral partners 

    • Guiding prospective patients through the inquiry, evaluation, scheduling, and surgical planning process 

    • Conducting consistent follow-up and patient engagement activities 

    • Managing sensitive conversations with professionalism, empathy, and discretion 

    • Monitoring and responding to patient inquiries generated through digital marketing and social media channels 

    • Maintaining accurate records of patient inquiries, referral sources, follow-up activities, and conversion metrics using CRM and patient management systems 

    • Working independently with minimal supervision while achieving measurable patient acquisition objectives 



Candidate Profile

We are specifically seeking an individual who is:

    • Fluent in English with excellent verbal and written communication skills 

    • Highly organized and detail-oriented 

    • Emotionally intelligent and empathetic 

    • Resourceful online and capable of conducting independent research 

    • Comfortable speaking with North American patients and families 

    • Self-motivated and capable of working remotely 

    • Professional, mature, and dependable 

    • Entrepreneurial in mindset and proactive in identifying opportunities 



Preferred Backgrounds

Strong preference will be given to candidates with experience in one or more of the following areas:

    • Patient Advocacy 

    • Patient Navigation 

    • Cardiac Patient Coordination 

    • Cardiovascular Services 

    • Medical Tourism 

    • International Patient Services 

    • Physician Relations 

    • Clinical Liaison Services 

    • Healthcare Business Development 

    • Healthcare Outreach 

    • Case Management 

    • Surgical Scheduling and Coordination 

    • Healthcare Marketing and Patient Acquisition 



Performance Expectations

This role is centered around patient acquisition, patient engagement, and patient conversion through trust and relationship-building over time—not high-pressure sales tactics.

The successful candidate will be expected to:

    • Develop a growing pipeline of qualified prospective patients 

    • Build referral relationships with healthcare professionals and organizations 

    • Maintain consistent follow-up with prospective patients 

    • Contribute directly to consultation bookings and surgical case development 

    • Create measurable patient acquisition opportunities for Heartline Clinics 

This position will include an initial evaluation period during which measurable progress toward patient identification, engagement, and pipeline development will be expected.



Compensation

Heartline Clinics intends to attract a high-caliber long-term professional and is prepared to offer compensation above standard market rates for the right candidate.

Compensation will include:

    • Competitive base salary 

    • Performance-based bonuses 

    • Significant incentive opportunities tied directly to patient acquisition and successful case development 



Ideal Candidate

This role is ideal for an individual who enjoys solving problems, building relationships, conducting independent research, and helping patients access life-changing medical care.

The successful candidate will be entrepreneurial in mindset, highly self-motivated, and capable of creating opportunities rather than simply responding to them.

If you are passionate about helping patients navigate complex healthcare decisions and have the ability to build trust-based relationships that lead to positive outcomes, we would welcome the opportunity to speak with you.

title: Virtual assistant
description:
This is the single best platform for hiring Filipino VAs and the one I recommend most strongly. It is specifically designed for hiring remote workers in the Philippines, the talent pool is large and serious, and workers there are accustomed to long term arrangements with Western employers. You post a job, applicants come to you, and you hire directly with no agency middleman taking a cut. A basic employer membership costs around $69 per month but is worth every dollar given the quality of candidates.

Upwork

The largest freelance platform in the world. You will find plenty of Filipino candidates here. The downside is that Upwork takes a percentage of every payment and candidates tend to be juggling multiple clients simultaneously rather than being dedicated to you. Better for short term or project based work than for a long term dedicated VA.

 Groups

There are several large
 groups specifically for Filipino VA job seekers. Search for Virtual Assistant Jobs Philippines, Filipino Virtual Assistants, and Online Filipino Workers. Posting in these groups is completely free and can produce strong candidates quickly. The downside is that you are doing more screening work yourself since there is no platform vetting.

My Recommendation

Post on OnlineJobs.ph as your primary channel and simultaneously post in two or three
 groups for free coverage. Skip Upwork for this particular role since you want someone dedicated and long term rather than a freelancer splitting attention across multiple clients.



YOUR JOB ADVERTISEMENT

Here is a complete ad ready to post on OnlineJobs.
 and adapt for
 groups.

What You Will Be Doing

, text message, and
 direct message following a script we provide.

Specific daily tasks include the following.

Using our lead finding software to identify local businesses without websites. Building professional websites for those businesses using our AI website builder. Sending outreach messages via
, text, and
 following our provided scripts. Responding to interested business owners promptly and professionally. Conducting brief follow up calls using our provided call script. Completing a client intake form during each follow up call. Sending follow up information to interested clients. Keeping the tracking sheet updated after every action.

s and messages will represent Dr. Jaffe's professional brand and must be warm, clear, and professional at all times.

You must have a stable internet connection and a quiet place to work and make calls.

Experience with virtual assistance, customer service, outreach, or sales support is preferred but not required. We will train the right person from scratch.



What We Offer

A starting rate of $4.00 USD per hour paid weekly via PayPal every Friday.

A consistent and predictable part time schedule of 10 hours per week to start.

Clear written scripts and instructions for every task so you are never guessing what to do.

A supportive and respectful working relationship with Dr. Jaffe's team.

Real opportunity to grow your hours and your responsibilities as the business grows. We are looking for someone who wants to build a long term working relationship, not just fill a short term contract.



How To Apply

Applications without all three components will not be considered. We look forward to hearing from you.

If you enjoy investigating complex operational problems, organizing information, and turning uncertainty into actionable recommendations, this role is built for you.



What You'll Own

title: Daily Thumbnail Designer (Photoshop) for How-To YouTube Content
description:
Hi! I'm looking for a thumbnail designer to work with me every day, long term. I make how-to and tutorial videos and I'm moving toward high-volume output, so I need someone who can produce thumbnails quickly, consistently, and on-brand every single day.



THE STYLE

All my thumbnails follow one consistent look:

- A cut-out presenter on one side.

- An app screenshot or logo on the other side, with a bold red arrow pointing to the key spot.

- Large uppercase text at the bottom in bright green and white.

I already have a finished Photoshop template plus all brand assets and reference thumbnails. Once we connect I'll share these with you, so you'll mainly be swapping the screenshot, arrow, text and presenter image for each new video and keeping everything sharp and consistent.



THE WORK

- Multiple thumbnails per day, every day, delivered reliably.

- This is built for volume, so speed and consistency matter as much as quality.



REQUIREMENTS

- Photoshop only. No Canva or other tools. This is important to me.

- A real understanding of what makes a thumbnail work: clear focal point, readable text, strong contrast.

- Reliable daily delivery.

- Good communication and open to feedback.



A PLUS

- Some experience with AI tools like ChatGPT for generating or cleaning up design elements. It is not the core of the job, but I use AI in my own workflow, so it helps if you are comfortable leaning on it to make things look clean.



PAY

$0.20 per thumbnail to start. I pay bonuses for designers who show real dedication and deliver consistently, and the rate goes up once you prove yourself reliable. There's room for steady, ongoing work for the right person.



TO APPLY

- Start your message with the word "ORANGE" so I know you read this fully.

- Share a few thumbnails you've made in Photoshop.

- Tell me how many you can realistically deliver per day.

title: Senior CATI Operations Manager — Remote, Market Research
description:
Senior CATI Operations Manager — Remote, Market Research

Employer: TKW Research Group (Australia / New Zealand)

Location: Remote — Philippines (Metro Manila or Cebu preferred for talent network access)

Engagement: Independent contractor, full-time equivalent



The Package — What You’ll Receive



TKW Research Group is a long-standing Australian/New Zealand market research firm, and we’re looking for a senior operations leader to take ownership of our CATI call floor — and to help shape what comes next. This is a senior, long-term partnership with a genuine strategic dimension, and the package reflects that:



• Lead the bridge to AI-assisted interviewing — the role includes contributing to a voicebot we’re developing with a tier-1 AI platform partner. Detail below.

• Direct line to the COO — you’ll report straight to the Chief Operating Officer of TKW Research Group. No middle layers.

• Base retainer: ?130,000 – ?180,000 PHP per month, commensurate with seniority, paid in arrears.

• 13th-month service bonus equivalent to one month’s base fee, paid every December.

• HMO allowance of up to ?50,000 per year, fully reimbursing premium private health cover for you and one dependent.

• Internet & equipment stipend of ?3,000 per month to support your home office setup.

• 10 days of paid leave per annum after 12 months of service, plus observed Australian public holidays without reduction to your base fee.

• Full training paid by TKW Research Group — structured onboarding plus ongoing dialler, CATI platform, and methodology training so you can perform at the highest level.

• Real ownership of how the floor runs, working directly with senior ANZ leadership — no middle layers, no agency markup.



About the Role



We run multi-market CATI fieldwork for ANZ and international market research clients, and we’re looking for an experienced operations manager to take ownership of the call floor. You’ll be responsible for fieldwork execution, dialler performance, quota management, and the productivity of our interviewer teams.



This is a senior, deeply hands-on role. You’ll have real autonomy over how the floor runs, but you’re also expected to roll up your sleeves — personally running shifts when needed and working directly with front-line interviewers, not just managing through layers. You’ll be accountable for hitting completion targets, maintaining quality, and keeping projects on budget.



The Hybrid Future — What Makes This Different



Every senior CATI manager knows what’s coming. Voicebots are going to reshape telephone interviewing within the next few years, and operations leaders fall into two camps: those who get sidelined by it, and those who lead the transition. We’re looking for the second kind.



TKW Research Group is partnering with a tier-1 multinational AI platform provider to develop a survey voicebot — conversational AI that can conduct natural-sounding interviews at scale. Your role in this isn’t theoretical: as the voicebot moves from pilot to production, you’ll be the operational lead running the blended human/voicebot floor. D
 which interviews go to human interviewers and which go to the voicebot. Managing quality across both channels. Calibrating the hybrid model to deliver better data than either could alone.



If you’ve been waiting for a CATI role where you get to shape what telephone research becomes — rather than manage its slow decline — this is it.



What You’ll Do



• Manage CATI fieldwork end-to-end: sample distribution, quota matrices, completion tracking.

• Personally run live shifts when required — this is not a desk-only role. You’ll be on the floor (remotely) directing interviewers in real time, especially during critical fieldwork windows and across time zones.

• Monitor dialler performance in real time — contact rates, call dispositions, interviewer yield — and make tactical calls to keep productivity up.

• Coordinate Shift Supervisors, QA staff, and a remote interviewer pool.

• Troubleshoot operational issues live and work directly with the survey programming team when scripts need adjustments.

• Maintain ISO 20252 / ESOMAR-aligned quality processes.

• Produce daily and weekly operational reporting for the COO.



What We’re Looking For



• 7+ years in CATI operations within a market research agency or fieldwork BPO, with 3+ years in a senior management role.

• Strong working knowledge of dialler logic, CATI platforms, and call centre KPIs.

• Genuinely good with front-line interviewers — you can motivate, coach, and direct base-level interviewers directly, not just manage through supervisors. The best candidates have come up through the floor and haven’t lost the common touch.

• Solid grasp of market research methodology: sampling, quotas, weighting basics, and QA standards (ISO 20252, ESOMAR).

• Forward-looking on AI in research — you don’t need technical AI experience, but you should see voicebots as an opportunity to lead, not a threat to manage around.

• Comfortable with flexible shift patterns to cover multi-timezone fieldwork (agreed in advance — not random).

• Home office with reliable power, dual internet connections, and a setup capable of running monitoring tools and video calls daily.

• Strong written and spoken English.



How to Apply



Send your CV plus a short note covering:

1. The largest CATI operation you’ve personally run (team size, markets, sample volumes).

2. The dialler platforms you know best.

3. Your shift flexibility.

4. Your view on how voicebots will reshape telephone interviewing — and where you see your role in that shift.

title: Short-Form Video Editor (Reels, TikToks, Shorts) | $10/Video | Long-Term
description:
About Us



CLT Content Lab is a done-for-you short-form content agency based in Charlotte, North Carolina. We produce social media content for service businesses and personal brands. Our work is published 5 days a week across multiple client accounts, so the editor who joins this role is editing real content that goes live, not test projects.





What You'll Be Doing



You will edit 10 to 20 short-form videos per week. Every video is vertical, 9:16, under 60 seconds. Most are talking head with B-roll. Some are voiceover with B-roll and motion graphics.



We are about to start producing content for outdoor living professionals (landscaping, hardscaping, patio and outdoor space builders). That means cinematic B-roll of real job sites, before and afters, time-lapses, and product showcases. If you enjoy editing visually rich footage, you'll like this work.





A typical edit includes:



Cutting filler words, ums, dead space, and bad takes



Punchy cuts on every beat to hold attention



Captions with clean styling, accurate timing, and emphasis on key words



B-roll overlays placed to match what the speaker is saying



Smooth transitions and sound effects that add energy without distracting



Subtle music beds layered under the cut



Light color correction for consistent look



Export ready to post, named correctly, delivered to a shared drive





What We're Looking For



Proficient in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve preferred. CapCut acceptable if your portfolio is strong.



Experience editing short-form content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, or YouTube Shorts



Fast turnaround. We expect a 24 to 48 hour turnaround per video.



Good English comprehension. You need to understand spoken English in the raw footage to cut it well.



Reliable internet and a computer that can handle 4K source files



Detail-oriented. We will give you a checklist for every video and we expect every item completed.





Pay



$10 USD per finished video. Paid weekly via PayPal.



At 10 to 20 videos per week, this is $100 to $200 per week of steady, recurring work.



We do not pay by the hour. We pay per finished video that meets our quality bar. If you are fast and good, your effective hourly rate goes up.





How to Apply



Reply to this listing with the following. (Applications missing any of these will not be reviewed.)



The word "PINEAPPLE" at the top of your message (so we know you read the full listing)



3 to 5 short-form videos you have edited. Drive or YouTube links only.



The software you use most for short-form editing



Your typical turnaround time per video



How many hours per week you can commit



Confirmation that you can receive PayPal payments



One sentence on why this role interests you



We will reply to qualifying applicants within 5 business days with a paid test edit. The test edit is $10 like any other video.

Looking forward to hearing from you.

title: Founder-Direct B2B Closer — $20K AI SaaS Deals to US Engineering Firms | Base + 5%+ 12-Month Trailing MRR
description:
US-based AI founder hiring ONE closer to sell a $20,000 setup + $1,500/month AI document-search tool to US civil engineering firms (50–250 employees). You work directly with me — no agency, no middle managers. Base + 5% of cash collected + 5% of recurring revenue for 12 months on every deal you close + a 13th-month bonus. Realistic earnings: ~$1,000/mo while you ramp, ~$2,400 the month your first deal lands, $4,000–$5,500/mo full-time at two closes a month. Phone-first, consultative, 4 hrs/day to start, expanding as you hit milestones.



If you have personally cold-dialed US prospects and closed B2B deals — and you want a founder-direct seat with real commission upside instead of another capped warm-lead gig — read on.





=========================================

THE OPPORTUNITY

=========================================



I'm a US-based AI founder and I built SalemWise myself. The tool solves a real, expensive headache for civil engineering firms: it instantly searches their entire history of project documents and finds exactly what an engineer needs in seconds, across decades of archives.



Here's the honest version of the demand: two firms found us through search engines while looking for this exact solution and reached out on their own. That's proof the pain is real and people pay to solve it — but it is two leads, not a pipeline. Your job is to build the pipeline: pick up the phone and turn that demand signal into booked discoveries at volume.



This is a ground-floor outbound role with a proven offer behind it. You sell to technically literate engineering leaders, the deals are $20K, and a confident human voice is the entire moat — this is exactly the kind of sale AI can't automate away. Finalists get a live product demo so you know precisely what you're putting your name behind.





=========================================

THE ROLE

=========================================



Cold calling (your primary motion): Dial roughly 100–130 US civil engineering firms per day using Apollo's parallel dialer. Get past gatekeepers, reach Managing Principals, Directors of Engineering, and BD Directors at firms of 50–250 people. Open with a one-line problem hook, qualify in 90 seconds, book the discovery.



Multi-touch follow-up: Layer LinkedIn DMs and Apollo
 sequences around the dials. The phone is the tip of the spear; the rest is reinforcement and re-engagement.



Full-cycle sales: Run the discovery, handle pricing and objections, close. I join for a 10-minute technical demo wherever it helps the deal.





=========================================

THE HONEST TRUTH

=========================================



This is a phone-first seat and I'm not going to dress it up.



Realistic baseline (Cognism 2026 industry average of ~3% cold-call connect rate, drawn from 200K+ analyzed calls): on a good day you'll get 5–10 live connects, 2–4 real conversations, and book 0–2 discoveries. Good weeks: 4–6 discoveries. Slow weeks: 1–2. Parallel dialing drives volume but adds a ~2-second pickup delay you'll learn to ride.



Month 1, you'll dial 2,000–3,000 numbers, hit voi
 more than half the time, get hung up on, and hear "we already tried ChatGPT and it didn't work" a couple times a week (I'll teach you the 20-second counter). You'll earn around $1,000 and book your first handful of discoveries. The real conversations cluster Tuesday–Thursday, roughly 9:30–11:30 AM the prospect's time.



Push through months 1 and 2 and month 3 starts paying. By month 6 you're somewhere completely different. The milestone ladder below is the structure I'm committing to — not a marketing pitch.



If month-1 dialing volume worries you, this isn't your seat. If you've been waiting for a real cold-call role with real upside, it is.





=========================================

COMPENSATION

=========================================



You earn three ways on every deal: base hourly, commission on cash collected, and trailing commission on recurring revenue.



THE MILESTONE LADDER (hourly only goes up):



  Start

   - 4 hrs/day — base $9.00/hr (~$792/mo)

   - 5% of cash collected + 5% of MRR (12 months trailing)

   - Plus $50 per qualified discovery booked, $100 per signed contract



  After deal #1

   - 5 hrs/day — base $9.50/hr (~$1,045/mo)

   - Same commission + a one-time $400 advancement bonus



  After deal #3

   - 6 hrs/day — base $10.00/hr (~$1,320/mo)

   - Same commission + a one-time $750 advancement bonus



  After deal #5 (full-time)

   - 8 hrs/day — base $11.00/hr (~$1,936/mo)

   - Same commission + a one-time $1,500 advancement bonus



  After deal #8

   - 8 hrs/day — base $12.00/hr (~$2,112/mo)

   - 6% of cash collected + 5% of MRR + a one-time $2,500 advancement bonus



HOW THE COMMISSION PAYS:

On a $20,000 setup, 5% of cash collected = $1,000, paid the week the customer's payment clears. The 5% trailing on the $1,500/month recurring then pays ~$75/month for the next 12 months — so every deal you close keeps paying you for a year.



Trailing commission is paid on recurring revenue actually collected, for as long as both the customer's subscription and your engagement with SalemWise stay active. (No collection in a given month — e.g., the customer churns — means no trailing for that month. Clean and simple.)



REALISTIC MONTHLY EARNINGS:

   - Month 1 (ramp, dialing a cold list): ~$1,000

   - Month 2 (rhythm settles, discoveries booked): ~$1,100–$1,300

   - Month 3 (first close lands): ~$2,400 that month, plus trailing begins

   - Full-time at two closes/month: $4,000–$5,500, climbing as trailing stacks



13TH-MONTH BONUS: Pro-rated and paid in December — one month of your average earnings (base + commission) over the year, standard PH practice, on top of everything above.



Payments via Wise, every Friday. No quarter-end delays.





=========================================

SCHEDULE

=========================================



4 hours/day, Monday–Friday, on US Eastern business hours: 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM ET.

   - That's roughly 9:00 PM – 1:00 AM Manila during US summer, and 10:00 PM – 2:00 AM Manila during US winter (it shifts one hour with US daylight saving).



This window is fixed because engineering principals pick up between 9 AM and noon their local time, and that's where dials convert. To make a 4-hour shift land inside that window, this role targets firms in the US Eastern and Central time zones to start; West Coast accounts open up as your hours expand to full-time. Weekends off.



If you can't work this late-night Manila shift consistently, please don't apply.





=========================================

WHAT I GIVE YOU ON DAY 1

=========================================



You won't burn week 1 waiting on me. Before you start, this is ready:



   - LinkedIn Sales Navigator with a saved list of 2,000+ qualified prospects matching the ICP

   - Apollo with phone numbers loaded, the parallel dialer configured, and
 sequences pre-built

   - A cold-call opener, a 90-second qualification script, and an objection cheat sheet covering the top 8 objections — "we already tried ChatGPT," "send me an
," "we use SharePoint search," "what's the price," "not interested," and the rest — each with a 15–30 second counter

   - A gatekeeper-navigation script for firms where principals don't list direct lines

   - DocuSign for contracts

   - Recordings of past discovery calls and demos so you can learn the pitch before your first dial



YOUR 8–10 WEEK RAMP (you're never thrown in cold):

   - Weeks 1–3: Start dialing with the scripts from day one while you absorb the product (recorded discoveries, a short AASHTO/ACI/AWWA primer, the 8-objection cheat sheet). Book discoveries; shadow me on the ones that convert.

   - Weeks 4–6: Run real discoveries with me on the call.

   - Weeks 7–10: Run discoveries solo.



You don't need a civil engineering background. You do need to commit to studying the basics. Strong B2B SaaS sales experience plus that willingness is the bar.





=========================================

WHO YOU ARE

=========================================



   - 3+ years B2B sales, including 2+ years cold-calling US prospects (not appointment-setting off warm or inbound lists)

   - A specific cold-call track record: you can name 3 past closed deals with company, deal size ($5K minimum), and confirm at least 2 came from outbound dials you personally made

   - Clear, easily understood US-market phone English. You'll be talking to 55-year-old principal engineers in cities like Houston and Atlanta — we'll confirm this with a short live voice check, no scripts

   - Hands-on with a power dialer (Apollo, Aircall, JustCall, Orum, PhoneBurner, or similar) and LinkedIn Sales Navigator

   - Set up to perform: stable wired internet (25 Mbps minimum), a UPS backup for outages, a dedicated work computer (not shared), and a noise-canceling USB headset (Jabra, Logitech, or equivalent — not Bluetooth earbuds). Need to upgrade the headset? I'll reimburse $75 on your first paycheck.





=========================================

THIS ISN'T YOUR SEAT IF

=========================================



   - You've never personally cold-dialed and closed a $5K+ B2B deal

   - Your background is primarily residential real-estate cold-calling (wholesale, probate, lease-up), mortgages, or customer service (B2B proptech / SaaS is welcome)

   - You can't work the late-night Manila window consistently

   - You need a guaranteed monthly minimum above ~$1,200 before deals land (expect ~$800–$1,100 to start, with the real upside post-revenue)





=========================================

HOW TO APPLY

=========================================



Open your reply with exactly this sentence (applications missing it won't be reviewed):



   "I have personally cold-dialed US prospects and closed at least one B2B deal of $5,000 or more, and I can work the US Eastern morning shift, Monday through Friday."



Platform requirement: OnlineJobs.ph ID Proof score of 70+ and a profile updated within the last 30 days.



Then send these 3 things:



1) A 60–90 second Loom video: introduce yourself, then walk me through the best cold-call-sourced B2B deal you ever closed — company, deal size, what you sold, the objection that nearly killed it, and how you handled it. At the start, read this aloud word-for-word:

   "I'm pitching SalemWise to a civil engineering principal at a 120-person firm. Their archive holds 7 TB of AASHTO and AWWA project documents going back to the 1980s. They're skeptical of AI."



2) Either a real cold-call recording you made in a past role (redact names/companies if needed), OR a 90-second mock against this scenario:

   "You're cold-calling the Director of Engineering at a 120-person civil firm in Denver to pitch an AI document-search tool. The receptionist just transferred you. He picks up — 'This is Mike.' Go."



3) Your 3 past closed deals (company, deal size, rough timeframe), plus two past managers I can contact as references. I'll check references at the final stage only — I won't contact anyone before then.



Subject line: Closer Application | [Your Name] | [Years cold-calling US deals] | [Earliest start date]





=========================================

THE HIRING PROCESS

=========================================



   - I review complete applications within 48 hours.

   - Top candidates: a 15-minute phone screen on the dialer you'll use day one (voice quality + live conversation).

   - Finalists: a 45-minute Google Meet with me, ending in a short live role-play — I play a skeptical 58-year-old principal engineer; you get past the gatekeeper, run discovery, and pitch.

   - Reference check with two past managers.

   - A 3-week paid trial at $1,000 flat. Clear, ramp-consistent KPIs: 1,500+ dials, 30+ real conversations, 4+ qualified discoveries booked, and 3+ discoveries shadowed with me. No closed deal is expected in the trial — closing is a month-3 outcome; the trial measures dialing, conversations, voice, and coachability.

   - Hit the trial KPIs and the long-term contract begins. If not, we part cleanly, no hard feelings.





Yermek

SalemWise Solutions

These models are split into parts so they can be printed in individual filament colors and snapped or glued together—no painting required.

A superhero bust breaking through a wall (hangable decor)



Pop culture helmets split by detail and color

Creative themed designs that fit in a kids' room, office, or collector shelf

Design clean, multi-part 3D printable models for FDM printers



Ensure models are split by color group (each color = separate file)



Add pegs, joints, and simple assembly features



Keep designs support-free or low-support



Deliver organized folders with labeled STL files



Provide basic preview renders and exploded layout if needed







---



Monthly Output Expectations:



You’ll be expected to produce 4–6 models per month, based on size and complexity:



1–2 large centerpiece models (wall busts, helmets, or props)



1–2 medium models (small helmets, creatures, masks, etc.)



1–2 small models or extras (mini decor pieces, accessories, bonus files)





Some may be simpler, some more intricate—but your job is to keep a consistent pace and maintain quality and creativity.





---



Software You Should Be Proficient With:



Blender, ZBrush, Fusion 360, or equivalent



Meshmixer / Netfabb (for slicing, repairing, and splitting parts)



Optional: slicers like PrusaSlicer, Bambu Studio, or Cura (to visualize your output)







---



Bonus Skills:



Familiar with cosplay, props, or display art



Understanding of tolerances and snap-fit mechanics



Capable of checking STL output for printability



Can do simple presentation renders







---



Pay & Schedule:



$1,300/month USD



Full-time, 40 hours/week expected



Long-term position with potential for bonuses, growth, and community recognition



Paid weekly (during onboarding), then biweekly/monthly



Must be self-motivated and communicative—this is a collaborative creative position







---



How to Apply:



To help us find the right fit, please include the following:



1. Start your message with the word: Modular





2. Send 2–3 examples of your own 3D printable models (bonus if multi-part or colored)

4. Give us 1 creative wall decor or helmet idea you think would make an awesome print





5. Share your average time to complete a full model

We’re building something fun, fan-focused, and print-friendly—and we’re looking for someone who wants to grow with us. If you live for clean meshes, cool designs, and geeking out over prints—let’s talk.
